title.zh: 卷132 志一百七 兵三 防军 陆军
title.en: Volume 132 Treatises 107: Military 3, Defense Forces, Army
title.raw: 卷132 志一百七 兵三 防军 陆军

sentences.zh: 志一百七

translations.literal: Treatise 107
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 107

sentences.zh: 兵三

translations.literal: Military 3
translations.idiomatic: Military, Part Three

sentences.zh: 防軍陸軍

translations.literal: Defense Forces; Army
translations.idiomatic: Defense Forces and the Army

sentences.zh: 防軍初皆召募，於八旗、綠營以外，別自成營，兵數多寡不定，分佈郡縣，遇寇警則隸於專征將帥，二百年間，調發徵戍，咸出於此。

translations.literal: Defense forces at first were all recruited; apart from the Eight Banners and Green Standard [troops], they separately formed camps of their own; troop numbers were of no fixed size; they were distributed among prefectures and counties; when bandit alarms arose they were subordinated to campaign commanders; over two hundred years, all deployments for garrison and campaign service came from this [source].
translations.idiomatic: Defense forces were originally raised entirely by recruitment. Outside the Eight Banners and the Green Standard Army, they formed separate corps of their own, with no fixed establishment. Scattered through the prefectures and counties, they passed under campaign commanders whenever bandit alarms arose. For two centuries, every call-up for garrison duty or field service came from these units.

sentences.zh: 若乾隆年台灣之役，乾、嘉間黔、楚征苗之役，嘉慶間川、陝教匪之役，道光年洋艘征撫之役，皆暫募勇營，事平旋撤。

translations.literal: Such as the Taiwan campaign in the Qianlong years, the Guizhou and Huguang Miao campaigns between the Qianlong and Jiaqing [reigns], the Sichuan and Shaanxi sectarian rebel campaigns in the Jiaqing [reign], and the campaigns against and pacification of foreign vessels in the Daoguang years — all temporarily recruited brave battalions; when affairs were settled they were at once disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiwan campaign under Qianlong, the Guizhou and Huguang campaigns against the Miao between the Qianlong and Jiaqing reigns, the Sichuan and Shaanxi sectarian rebellions under Jiaqing, and the wars of suppression and negotiation with foreign ships under Daoguang all relied on brave battalions raised for the occasion and disbanded as soon as peace returned.

sentences.zh: 故嘉慶七年，楚北初設提督，即以勇丁充補標兵，道光十七年，以練勇隸於鎮筸鎮標，二十三年，以防守海疆之水陸義勇三萬六千人仍遣回本籍，無防、練軍之名也。

translations.literal: Therefore in the seventh year of Jiaqing, when a provincial commander was first established in northern Huguang, brave soldiers were used to fill out the garrison quota; in the seventeenth year of Daoguang, drilled braves were placed under the Zhenqian garrison banner; in the twenty-third year, thirty-six thousand land and water militia defending the maritime frontier were still sent back to their native places — there were no names of defense or training forces.
translations.idiomatic: Thus in the seventh year of Jiaqing, when a provincial commander was first posted to northern Huguang, brave recruits were used to fill the regular garrison rolls. In the seventeenth year of Daoguang, drilled volunteers were attached to the Zhenqian garrison banner; in the twenty-third year, thirty-six thousand coastal militia on land and sea were sent home again. The titles “defense forces” and “training forces” did not yet exist.

sentences.zh: 道、咸間，粵匪事起，各省多募勇自衛，張國樑募潮州勇丁最多。

translations.literal: Between the Daoguang and Xianfeng [reigns], when the Cantonese rebels arose, each province mostly recruited braves for self-defense; Zhang Guoliang recruited the most Chaozhou brave soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taiping rebellion broke out in the Daoguang and Xianfeng era, provinces across the empire raised braves for local defense; Zhang Guoliang mustered the largest body of Chaozhou volunteers.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，命曾國籓治湖南練勇，定湘軍營哨之制，為防軍營制所昉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, Zeng Guofan was ordered to manage the drilling of braves in Hunan and to fix the battalion and platoon system of the Xiang Army — the origin of the defense-force camp system.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng, Zeng Guofan was charged with training Hunan volunteers and codified the battalion-and-platoon organization of the Xiang Army, which became the model for later defense-force establishments.

sentences.zh: 迨國籓奉命東征，湘勇外益以淮勇，多至二百營。

translations.literal: When Guofan received orders for the eastern campaign, beyond Xiang braves Huai braves were added, reaching as many as two hundred battalions.
translations.idiomatic: When Zeng Guofan marched east on imperial orders, Huai volunteers joined the Xiang forces, and the combined corps grew to some two hundred battalions.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠平西陲，所部楚軍亦百數十營。

translations.literal: When Zuo Zongtang pacified the western frontier, the Chu Army under his command also numbered well over a hundred battalions.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang’s pacification of the northwest was carried out by a Chu Army of well over a hundred battalions as well.

sentences.zh: 軍事甫定，各省險要，悉以勇營留防，舊日綠營，遂同虛設。

translations.literal: When military affairs had just been settled, every strategic point in the provinces was garrisoned by brave battalions left on defense; the old Green Standard [forces] thus became virtually nominal.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as the fighting ended, strategic posts in every province were held by volunteer battalions left behind for garrison duty, and the old Green Standard Army became a hollow formality.

sentences.zh: 綠營兵月餉不及防勇四分之一，升擢擁滯，咸辭兵就勇。

translations.literal: Green Standard soldiers’ monthly pay did not reach one quarter of defense braves’; promotion was congested; all resigned from regular service to join the braves.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard pay amounted to less than a quarter of what defense volunteers received, promotion was blocked, and men left the regular rolls in droves to enlist as braves.

sentences.zh: 粵、捻既平，左宗棠諸臣建議，防營誠為勁旅，有事則兵不如勇，無事則分汛巡守，宜以制兵為練兵，而於直隸、江、淮南北扼要之處，留勇營屯駐，遂有防軍之稱。

translations.literal: After the Cantonese and Nian [rebels] were pacified, Zuo Zongtang and other ministers proposed: defense camps were truly crack troops; when there was business, regular soldiers were inferior to braves; when there was no business, they were divided for garrison patrol; it was fitting to use regular troops as drilled troops, while at strategic points north and south along the Zhili, Yangtze, and Huai [lines], brave battalions should be retained in garrison — hence the name defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: After the suppression of the Taiping and Nian rebels, Zuo Zongtang and others argued that the defense camps had proved themselves elite formations: in war regulars could not match the volunteers, while in peace they could still be posted for patrol and garrison. Regular troops should be retrained as drilled forces, but volunteer battalions should remain stationed at the strategic junctions of Zhili and the Yangtze–Huai region. From this policy came the term “defense forces.”

sentences.zh: 練軍始自咸豐間，以勇營日多，屢令統兵大臣以勇補兵額，而以餘勇備緩急，尚無別練之師。

translations.literal: Training forces began in the Xianfeng period; as brave battalions daily increased, commanders were repeatedly ordered to use braves to fill regular quotas while keeping surplus braves for emergencies — there was still no separately drilled army.
translations.idiomatic: Training forces date from the Xianfeng period. As volunteer battalions multiplied, field commanders were repeatedly told to fill regular quotas with volunteers and keep the remainder in reserve, but there was not yet a distinct drilled army as such.

sentences.zh: 至同治元年，始令各疆吏以練勇人數口糧，悉數報部稽核。

translations.literal: Not until the first year of Tongzhi were all frontier governors ordered to report drilled braves’ numbers and rations in full to the ministry for audit.
translations.idiomatic: Only in the first year of Tongzhi were provincial governors required to report the full head count and ration rolls of drilled volunteers to the Board for audit.

sentences.zh: 是年於天津創練洋槍隊。

translations.literal: That year at Tianjin a drilled foreign-rifle corps was created.
translations.idiomatic: That same year a foreign-rifle training detachment was established at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 二年，以直隸額兵酌改練軍。

translations.literal: In the second year, Zhili quota troops were suitably converted into training forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, a portion of Zhili’s regular establishment was reorganized as training forces.

sentences.zh: 四年，兵部、戶部諸臣會議選練直隸六軍，始定練軍之名。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, ministers of the Board of War and Board of Revenue met and selected and drilled the six Zhili armies — the name training forces was first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, officials of the Boards of War and Revenue met to select and drill the six Zhili armies, and the term “training forces” was formally adopted.

sentences.zh: 各省練軍乃踵行之。

translations.literal: Each province’s training forces then followed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The provinces then followed suit with training forces of their own.

sentences.zh: 練軍雖在額設制兵內選擇，而營哨餉章，悉准湘、淮軍制，與防軍同。

translations.literal: Although training forces were chosen from within the quota of regular troops, camp, platoon, and pay regulations all followed the Xiang and Huai army systems, the same as defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: Training forces were drawn from the regular establishment, but their battalion organization, platoon structure, and pay scales followed the Xiang and Huai models, identical to those of the defense forces.

sentences.zh: 其綠營制兵，分佈列郡汛地，練軍則屯聚於通都重鎮，簡器械，勤訓練，以散為整，重在屯防要地，其用亦與防軍同，故練軍亦防軍也。

translations.literal: Green Standard regulars were distributed among the garrison posts of the various prefectures; training forces were massed in great cities and key towns, with weapons selected and training diligent, turning dispersion into concentration, emphasizing garrison defense of strategic places — their use was also the same as defense forces; hence training forces were also defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard regulars were scattered across prefectural garrison posts, while training forces were concentrated in major cities and strategic towns, with better arms and constant drill, turning a dispersed force into a concentrated one to hold vital points. Their function matched that of the defense forces, and in practice the training forces were defense forces as well.

sentences.zh: 同治、光緒間，各省所增編防、練軍，兵部、戶部於光緒二十四年核其總數，直隸練軍一萬一千人，留防淮軍三萬一千人，新軍一萬一千四百人，毅軍一萬人，奉天練軍一萬一千四百人，吉林防軍八千五百九十八人，練軍四千四百三十八人，黑龍江練軍七千九百七十一人，山西練軍四千九百人，河南防軍九千一百九十人，陝西防、練軍一萬四千四百五十人，甘肅防軍一萬二千五百人，新疆防軍二萬七千八百四十五人，塔爾巴哈台勇營二千四百三十二人，四川勇營一萬五千六百九十八人，雲南防軍一萬五千三十三人，貴州練軍九千四百八十六人，廣東勇營一萬一千八百人，廣西勇營一萬六千九百四十人，湖南練軍一萬二千九百七十人，湖北勇營一萬二千六百九十人，新軍一千九十三人，江西防軍九千三百六十三人，安徽防、練軍一萬一千二百九十人，江蘇防軍二萬三千七百九十人，自強軍三千一百七十人，得勝軍三千人，浙江防軍二萬一千三百人，山東防軍一萬三千九百五十人，福建防軍一萬五百四十人，各省防軍、練勇凡三十六萬餘人，歲需餉銀二千餘萬兩。

translations.literal: Between Tongzhi and Guangxu, the defense and training forces added and organized in each province — in the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu the Boards of War and Revenue audited their totals: Zhili training forces 11,000; Huai Army left on defense 31,000; New Army 11,400; Yi Army 10,000; Fengtian training forces 11,400; Jilin defense forces 8,598, training forces 4,438; Heilongjiang training forces 7,971; Shanxi training forces 4,900; Henan defense forces 9,190; Shaanxi defense and training forces 14,450; Gansu defense forces 12,500; Xinjiang defense forces 27,845; Tarbagatai brave battalions 2,432; Sichuan brave battalions 15,698; Yunnan defense forces 15,033; Guizhou training forces 9,486; Guangdong brave battalions 11,800; Guangxi brave battalions 16,940; Hunan training forces 12,970; Hubei brave battalions 12,690, New Army 1,093; Jiangxi defense forces 9,363; Anhui defense and training forces 11,290; Jiangsu defense forces 23,790, Self-Strengthening Army 3,170, Victorious Army 3,000; Zhejiang defense forces 21,300; Shandong defense forces 13,950; Fujian defense forces 10,540; defense forces and drilled braves in all provinces totaled over 360,000; annual pay required over 20 million taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns the provinces expanded their defense and training forces. In the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu the Boards of War and Revenue tallied them as follows: Zhili training forces, 11,000; Huai Army on garrison duty, 31,000; New Army, 11,400; Yi Army, 10,000; Fengtian training forces, 11,400; Jilin defense forces 8,598 and training forces 4,438; Heilongjiang training forces, 7,971; Shanxi training forces, 4,900; Henan defense forces, 9,190; Shaanxi defense and training forces, 14,450; Gansu defense forces, 12,500; Xinjiang defense forces, 27,845; Tarbagatai brave battalions, 2,432; Sichuan brave battalions, 15,698; Yunnan defense forces, 15,033; Guizhou training forces, 9,486; Guangdong brave battalions, 11,800; Guangxi brave battalions, 16,940; Hunan training forces, 12,970; Hubei brave battalions 12,690 and New Army 1,093; Jiangxi defense forces, 9,363; Anhui defense and training forces, 11,290; Jiangsu defense forces 23,790, Self-Strengthening Army 3,170, and Victorious Army 3,000; Zhejiang defense forces, 21,300; Shandong defense forces, 13,950; Fujian defense forces, 10,540. Defense forces and drilled volunteers in all provinces numbered more than 360,000 men and consumed over twenty million taels of silver a year.

sentences.zh: 其後綠營兵屢加裁汰，各省衛戍之責，遂專屬於防、練軍。

translations.literal: Thereafter Green Standard troops were repeatedly cut; the responsibility for garrison defense in each province thus fell solely on defense and training forces.
translations.idiomatic: As the Green Standard Army was repeatedly reduced, provincial garrison duty passed entirely to the defense and training forces.

sentences.zh: 光緒中葉後，防、練軍改為巡防隊。

translations.literal: After the middle of the Guangxu [reign], defense and training forces were changed to patrol-defense detachments.
translations.idiomatic: After the mid-Guangxu period, defense and training forces were redesignated as patrol garrisons.

sentences.zh: 光、宣之間，又改為陸軍。

translations.literal: Between Guangxu and Xuantong, they were again changed to land forces.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Guangxu and Xuantong reigns they were renamed again as the Army.

sentences.zh: 至宣統三年，各省巡防隊猶未裁盡也。

translations.literal: Down to the third year of Xuantong, patrol-defense detachments in the provinces had still not been fully disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: As late as the third year of Xuantong, patrol garrisons had not yet been fully abolished in every province.

sentences.zh: 茲列同、光、宣三朝改設防、練軍規畫於篇，而以陸軍新制附焉。

translations.literal: Here the plans for establishing defense and training forces in the three reigns of Tongzhi, Guangxu, and Xuantong are set forth in this chapter, with the new army system appended.
translations.idiomatic: This chapter records how defense and training forces were reorganized under Tongzhi, Guangxu, and Xuantong, with the new army regulations appended.

sentences.zh: 防軍，同治元年，直隸省於大沽協標六營內選練五百人，復增至二千五百人，分為五營，營分十隊，設總統一人，翼長二人，各營管帶一人，副管帶二人，正副令官二人，帶隊官十人，分隊官二十人。

translations.literal: Defense forces: in the first year of Tongzhi, Zhili province selected and drilled five hundred men from six cooperative garrison battalions at Dagu, then increased them to two thousand five hundred, divided into five battalions; each battalion into ten squads; one commander-in-chief, two wing chiefs, each battalion one commandant and two deputy commandants, two chief and deputy order officers, ten squad leaders, twenty squad deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Defense forces: In the first year of Tongzhi, Zhili selected five hundred men from six cooperative garrison battalions at Dagu for drill, later expanded to 2,500 organized into five battalions of ten squads each, with one overall commander, two wing officers, a commandant and two deputies per battalion, two order officers, ten squad leaders, and twenty assistant squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨於江西省額兵一萬二千人內，嚴汰老弱，增補精銳，分為二班，一班調至省城操練，一班留防汛地，半年換班。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen, from within Jiangxi’s quota of twelve thousand troops, strictly eliminated the old and weak, supplemented with elite troops, divided into two shifts — one shift transferred to the provincial capital for drill, one shift left at garrison posts, rotating every half year.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen took Jiangxi’s quota of 12,000 troops, culled the aged and unfit, filled the ranks with picked men, and divided them into two reliefs: one drilled at the provincial capital while the other held the garrison posts, with rotation every six months.

sentences.zh: 其赴操者，酌加練費，較募勇之費不及其半，練成即調赴前敵助戰。

translations.literal: Those sent to drill received an appropriate addition of drill pay, less than half the cost of recruiting braves; once drilled they were transferred to the front to assist in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Men under drill received extra training pay amounting to less than half the cost of hired volunteers, and once trained they were sent to the front as reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 二年，劉長佑以直隸省營務積年廢弛，各營兵數多寡懸殊，號令不一，乃改仿湘軍成規，以五百人為一營，設營官、哨隊官及親兵，分別隊伍旂幟，申明號令，改設六軍，凡築營結陣諸法，一律講求。

translations.literal: In the second year, Liu Changyou, because Zhili’s camp affairs had been neglected for years, with battalion strengths greatly unequal and orders not uniform, reformed by imitating the Xiang Army’s established rules: five hundred men per battalion, with battalion officers, platoon and squad officers, and personal guards; distinguishing units by flags; clarifying orders; reorganizing into six armies; all methods of camp building and battle formation were uniformly studied.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Liu Changyou found Zhili’s camps long neglected, with wildly uneven strengths and confused command. He adopted the Xiang Army model: battalions of five hundred with battalion, platoon, and squad officers plus bodyguards; distinct flags and clear signals; six armies reorganized; and systematic instruction in camp layout and battle formation.

sentences.zh: 其步隊營制，設營官一人，哨官四人，哨長五人，什長四十人，正兵三百六十人，營官親兵五十人，哨官護兵四十人，營官自率中哨，凡五百人。

translations.literal: Its infantry battalion system: one battalion officer, four platoon officers, five platoon chiefs, forty squad corporals, three hundred sixty regular soldiers, fifty battalion-officer bodyguards, forty platoon-officer escorts; the battalion officer personally led the center platoon — five hundred men in all.
translations.idiomatic: The infantry battalion comprised one battalion officer, four platoon officers, five platoon chiefs, forty corporals, 360 rank-and-file, fifty bodyguards for the battalion officer, forty escorts for the platoon officers, and the battalion officer commanding the center platoon — 500 men in total.

sentences.zh: 其馬隊營制，設營官一人，幫辦二人，督隊官五人，每哨五棚，每棚什長一人，正兵九人，營官自率中哨，合夥兵、馬夫凡三百十六人。

translations.literal: Its cavalry battalion system: one battalion officer, two assistants, five squad supervisors; each platoon five tents; each tent one corporal, nine regular soldiers; the battalion officer personally led the center platoon — including partners, soldiers, and grooms, three hundred sixteen men in all.
translations.idiomatic: The cavalry battalion had one battalion officer, two assistants, five squad supervisors, five tents per platoon with one corporal and nine troopers each, and the battalion officer leading the center platoon — 316 men including partners and grooms.

sentences.zh: 保定練軍，馬、步、守兵一千九百五十人為一軍，宣化練軍，一千四百八十人為一軍，古北口練軍，二千四百十人為一軍，大名練軍，一千二百三十四人為一軍，正定練軍，一千四百八十人為一軍，通永練軍，一千七百五十四人為一軍，共編為六軍。

translations.literal: Baoding training forces — cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops, one thousand nine hundred fifty men as one army; Xuanhua training forces, one thousand four hundred eighty as one army; Gubeikou training forces, two thousand four hundred ten as one army; Daming training forces, one thousand two hundred thirty-four as one army; Zhengding training forces, one thousand four hundred eighty as one army; Tongyong training forces, one thousand seven hundred fifty-four as one army — altogether organized as six armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Baoding training army numbered 1,950 cavalry, infantry, and garrison troops; Xuanhua, 1,480; Gubeikou, 2,410; Daming, 1,234; Zhengding, 1,480; and Tongyong, 1,754 — six armies in all.

sentences.zh: 五年，令遵化等處各駐防軍，每軍定為步隊二千人，馬隊五百人，在督標、提標內選取，凡一萬五千人，分為六軍，頒練兵章程十七條，隸總督節制，以防畿輔。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, garrison forces at Zunhua and other places were ordered: each army fixed at two thousand infantry and five hundred cavalry, selected from within the governor’s and provincial commander’s banners — fifteen thousand in all, divided into six armies; seventeen articles of drill regulations promulgated; subordinate to the governor’s control, to defend the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the garrisons at Zunhua and elsewhere were fixed at 2,000 infantry and 500 cavalry per army, drawn from the governor’s and commander’s banners — 15,000 men in six armies under seventeen articles of drill regulations, all under the governor to defend the capital approaches.

sentences.zh: 又於六軍外續練防勇二軍。

translations.literal: Beyond the six armies, two more defense-brave armies were additionally drilled.
translations.idiomatic: Two additional defense volunteer armies were drilled beyond the six armies.

sentences.zh: 以奉天留防隊伍調補直隸練軍缺額。

translations.literal: Fengtian garrison forces left on defense were transferred to fill vacancies in Zhili’s training forces.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison units left in Fengtian were transferred to fill gaps in Zhili’s training forces.

sentences.zh: 其訓練京營，由神機營量增兵額。

translations.literal: Training of the capital garrison was handled by increasing the Shenjiying’s troop quota as needed.
translations.idiomatic: Capital garrison training was handled by augmenting the Shenjiying establishment as required.

sentences.zh: 是年，左宗棠以福建省綠營額冘餉薄，乃裁兵十成之四，即以裁餉加留營之兵，並營操練。

translations.literal: That year, Zuo Zongtang, because Fujian’s Green Standard quota was excessive and pay thin, cut four tenths of the troops and applied the savings from the cut to the troops retained in camp, combining camps for drill.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zuo Zongtang found Fujian’s Green Standard rolls bloated and pay meager. He cut forty percent of the troops and applied the savings to those who remained, consolidating camps for joint drill.

sentences.zh: 六年，丁寶楨于山東省增練馬隊三千人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Ding Baozhen in Shandong province additionally drilled three thousand cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Ding Baozhen added three thousand cavalry to Shandong’s drilled forces.

sentences.zh: 七年，以各省綠營日益孱弱，令各省以壯健練勇易之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, because Green Standard [forces] in each province daily grew weaker, each province was ordered to replace them with sturdy drilled braves.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, as the Green Standard Army weakened everywhere, the provinces were ordered to replace weak troops with fit drilled volunteers.

sentences.zh: 令曾國籓經理直隸省練兵事宜，就全省綠營內抽練六千人，仿勇營規制，分地巡防。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was ordered to manage Zhili’s troop-drill affairs; from the whole province’s Green Standard [forces] six thousand were selected and drilled, imitating the brave-battalion system, assigned to patrol by region.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was put in charge of drilling in Zhili. Six thousand men were drawn from the provincial Green Standard rolls, organized on the volunteer model, and assigned to regional patrol.

sentences.zh: 海防議起，調駐天津，分中、左、右、前、後五營，與勇營相犄角。

translations.literal: When coastal defense was debated, they were transferred to garrison Tianjin, divided into center, left, right, front, and rear five battalions, mutually supporting with brave battalions.
translations.idiomatic: When coastal defense became urgent, they were posted to Tianjin in five battalions — center, left, right, front, and rear — to work in concert with the volunteer camps.

sentences.zh: 八年，曾國籓以軍事既竣，宜練兵不宜練勇，而勇營良法為練軍所當參用者，一、文法宜簡，一、事權宜專，一、情意宜洽。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Zeng Guofan held that since military affairs were concluded, regular troops should be drilled rather than braves, yet three good methods of brave camps that training forces ought to adopt were: first, regulations should be simple; second, authority should be concentrated; third, feeling should be harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Zeng Guofan argued that with the wars over, the state should drill regulars rather than volunteers, while the training forces should adopt three volunteer practices: simple regulations, concentrated authority, and close rapport between officers and men.

sentences.zh: 減兵增餉，汰弱留強，嚴杜頂替之弊。

translations.literal: Reduce troops and increase pay; eliminate the weak and retain the strong; strictly stop the abuse of substitutes.
translations.idiomatic: He cut rolls and raised pay, kept the strong and discharged the weak, and cracked down on men who sent substitutes.

sentences.zh: 於原有練軍四千人外，古北口、正定、保定各練千人，統以東南戰將。

translations.literal: Beyond the original four thousand training troops, at Gubeikou, Zhengding, and Baoding one thousand each were drilled, all commanded by southeastern campaign generals.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the existing 4,000 training troops, he drilled 1,000 more each at Gubeikou, Zhengding, and Baoding, placing them under generals from the southeastern campaigns.

sentences.zh: 練成之後，分為四軍。

translations.literal: After drilling was complete, they were divided into four armies.
translations.idiomatic: When training was complete, they were organized into four armies.

sentences.zh: 以二軍駐京北，二軍駐京南，俟功效既著，增練五千人。

translations.literal: Two armies garrisoned north of the capital, two south of the capital; when results were evident, five thousand more would be drilled.
translations.idiomatic: Two armies were posted north of Beijing and two south; once results were clear, another 5,000 men would be trained.

sentences.zh: 全省防營於未撤之九營外，以劉銘傳全部淮軍駐防張秋，以督標親軍砲隊營及前營副營駐天津，以親軍砲隊營駐大沽砲台，以盛字中軍六營、左軍三營，仁軍二營，馬隊五營駐馬廠、青縣，於運河西岸築砲台五座，駐盛字前軍三營、右軍三營、老左軍一營，於滄洲駐樂字中、左各一營，其盛字營兼辦屯田，以衛畿輔。

translations.literal: Province-wide defense camps: apart from nine battalions not yet withdrawn, Liu Mingchuan’s entire Huai Army garrisoned Zhangqiu; the governor’s-banner personal-artillery battalion and front-battalion deputy battalion garrisoned Tianjin; the personal-artillery battalion garrisoned the Dagu batteries; six Sheng-character center-army battalions, three left-army battalions, two Ren-army battalions, and five cavalry battalions garrisoned Machang and Qingxian; five batteries were built on the west bank of the Grand Canal; three Sheng-character front-army battalions, three right-army battalions, and one old left-army battalion garrisoned Cangzhou; one Le-character center battalion and one left battalion garrisoned there; the Sheng-character camps also undertook military colonies to guard the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond nine defense battalions not yet disbanded, Liu Mingchuan’s entire Huai Army held Zhangqiu; the governor’s personal artillery and a front-battalion detachment held Tianjin; personal artillery held the Dagu forts; six Sheng center battalions, three left battalions, two Ren battalions, and five cavalry units held Machang and Qingxian, with five batteries built west of the Grand Canal; three Sheng front, three right, and one old left battalion held Cangzhou; one Le center and one Le left battalion were also posted there; Sheng units ran military farms as well, all to shield the capital district.

sentences.zh: 是年，丁日昌以江蘇省自淮軍全部撤防以後，江蘇撫標兵僅有一千六百餘人，乃裁汰老弱，補以勇丁，分左右二營，練習洋槍及開花砲諸技。

translations.literal: That year, Ding Richang, because after the entire Huai Army withdrew from Jiangsu the Jiangsu governor’s-banner troops numbered only a little over sixteen hundred, cut the old and weak and supplemented with brave soldiers, forming left and right two battalions, drilling in foreign rifles and explosive-shell artillery techniques.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ding Richang found that after the Huai Army left Jiangsu, the governor’s banner could field only about 1,600 men. He cut the unfit, filled the ranks with volunteers, formed left and right battalions, and trained them in foreign rifles and breech-loading artillery.

sentences.zh: 馬新貽以江南全省額兵一萬二千七百餘人，分防各處，徒有其名，必須化散為整，始能轉弱為強，乃於督標內選千人為左右營，浦口、瓜洲營內選五百人為中營，揚州、泰州營內選五百人為前營，駐省城訓練，於徐州鎮標內選千人為徐防新兵左右營，以地方之輕重，定練兵之多寡。

translations.literal: Ma Xinyi held that Jiangnan’s whole-province quota of over twelve thousand seven hundred troops, distributed for defense everywhere, had only the name — dispersion must be turned into concentration before weakness could become strength; thus from the governor’s banner one thousand were chosen as left and right battalions; from Pukou and Guazhou camps five hundred as center battalion; from Yangzhou and Taizhou camps five hundred as front battalion, garrisoned at the provincial capital for training; from Xuzhou garrison banner one thousand as Xuzhou-defense new-army left and right battalions — according to each place’s importance, fixing how many to drill.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xinyi saw Jiangnan’s 12,700 quota troops scattered in name only across countless posts. Only by concentrating them could weakness become strength. He picked 1,000 from the governor’s banner for left and right battalions, 500 from Pukou and Guazhou for a center battalion, 500 from Yangzhou and Taizhou for a front battalion, all drilled at the provincial capital, and 1,000 from the Xuzhou garrison for new left and right battalions — scaling drill to each region’s strategic weight.

sentences.zh: 劉錦棠以新疆全境自回民亂後，旗營零落殆盡，乃於烏魯木齊創設標兵，於天山南北路各置額兵，新疆所有駐防旗兵，歸併伊犁整頓，別以精騎重兵居中屯駐，為南北各路策應之師。

translations.literal: Liu Jintang, because after the Muslim rebellion the whole of Xinjiang’s banner garrisons were nearly destroyed, created garrison troops at Urumqi, placed quota troops on the northern and southern routes of the Tianshan, consolidated all Xinjiang garrison banner troops under reorganized Yili, and separately stationed elite cavalry and heavy troops in the center as a force to support north and south routes.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jintang found Xinjiang’s banner garrisons shattered after the Muslim rebellions. He created garrison troops at Urumqi, posted quota forces on both sides of the Tianshan, consolidated Xinjiang’s banner garrisons under a reorganized Yili command, and stationed elite cavalry and heavy infantry in the center to support both routes.

sentences.zh: 崇實以四川省軍事漸定，酌裁防軍，選練旗、綠各營。

translations.literal: Chong Shi, as Sichuan’s military affairs gradually settled, suitably cut defense forces and selected and drilled banner and Green Standard camps.
translations.idiomatic: As Sichuan quieted, Chong Shi trimmed the defense forces and selected banner and Green Standard units for drill.

sentences.zh: 九年，曾國籓於直隸省增募馬勇千人，分為四營，原有額兵，增足萬人，分練馬隊、步隊，奏定各營哨之制，及底餉、練餉、出征加餉之制，為北方重鎮。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Zeng Guofan in Zhili additionally recruited one thousand cavalry braves, divided into four battalions; original quota troops were increased to ten thousand; cavalry and infantry were drilled separately; he memorialized fixing each battalion and platoon system and the systems of base pay, drill pay, and campaign supplemental pay — a northern strategic strongpoint.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Zeng Guofan raised another 1,000 cavalry volunteers in four battalions, brought Zhili’s regular rolls up to 10,000, and drilled separate cavalry and infantry commands. He memorialized battalion and platoon tables plus base pay, training pay, and campaign supplements, making Zhili the empire’s northern bastion.

sentences.zh: 十年，鮑源深以山西省撫標兵仿曾國籓直隸練兵之法，選練馬隊一營，步隊二營，以次推行各鎮。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Bao Yuanshen had Shanxi’s governor’s-banner troops imitate Zeng Guofan’s Zhili drilling method, selecting and drilling one cavalry battalion and two infantry battalions, extending step by step to each garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Bao Yuanshen applied Zeng Guofan’s Zhili model to Shanxi’s governor’s banner: one cavalry and two infantry battalions drilled first, then extended to every garrison.

sentences.zh: 吳棠以四川全省額兵類多疲弱，乃歸併訓練，得精壯萬人。

translations.literal: Wu Tang held that Sichuan’s whole-province quota troops were mostly weak; he consolidated them for training and obtained ten thousand elite troops.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tang found most of Sichuan’s quota troops unfit, consolidated them for training, and produced 10,000 effective soldiers.

sentences.zh: 王文韶以苗疆戡定，所有湖南省留防軍三十營，分布於湖南、貴州接壤之區，又於撫標、提標內各選練精壯一營。

translations.literal: Wang Wenshao, as the Miao frontier was pacified, had Hunan’s thirty defense battalions left on garrison distributed along the Hunan–Guizhou border region; furthermore from the governor’s and commander’s banners one elite battalion each was selected and drilled.
translations.idiomatic: After the Miao frontier was pacified, Wang Wenshao kept thirty Hunan defense battalions along the Guizhou border and drilled one elite battalion each from the governor’s and commander’s banners.

sentences.zh: 十二年，令陝甘督臣左宗棠、雲貴督臣岑毓英各選所部勇丁，以補營兵之額。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Shaanxi-Gansu Governor Zuo Zongtang and Yunnan-Guizhou Governor Cen Yuying were each ordered to select brave soldiers from their commands to fill regular battalion quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Zuo Zongtang in Shaanxi-Gansu and Cen Yuying in Yunnan-Guizhou were ordered to fill regular quotas with picked volunteers from their commands.

sentences.zh: 是時中外臣工皆注意練兵。

translations.literal: At this time civil and military officials at court and in the provinces all paid attention to drilling troops.
translations.idiomatic: Court and provincial officials alike were now focused on military drill.

sentences.zh: 李宗羲謂勇與兵有主客聚散勤惰之異，未可易勇為兵。

translations.literal: Li Zongxi said braves and regular soldiers differed as host and guest, concentrated and dispersed, diligent and idle — braves could not simply replace regulars.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongxi warned that volunteers and regulars differed in status, cohesion, and discipline, and that volunteers could not simply be swapped into the regular rolls.

sentences.zh: 王凱泰謂各省練兵，宜令更番換防，雲、貴蕩平以後，兩省制兵亦宜換防調操，以杜久駐疲惰之漸。

translations.literal: Wang Kaitai said provincial drilling should rotate garrisons in relays; after Yunnan and Guizhou were pacified, both provinces’ regular troops should also rotate garrisons for drill, to stop the gradual slackening of long stationing.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kaitai urged rotating garrisons for drill in every province; after Yunnan and Guizhou were pacified, their regulars should rotate as well, lest long postings breed idleness.

sentences.zh: 兵部諸臣會議，以同治初年創議練兵，京師神機營及直隸省六軍，別籌練餉，特立營制。

translations.literal: Board of War ministers met and held that in the early Tongzhi period, when troop drilling was first proposed, the capital Shenjiying and Zhili’s six armies had separate drill funds raised and a distinct camp system established.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of War noted that early Tongzhi drill reforms for the Shenjiying and Zhili’s six armies had separate training funds and their own camp organization.

sentences.zh: 福建、浙江、廣東、江蘇等省，皆就所減之餉加於練軍。

translations.literal: Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Jiangsu, and other provinces all added the pay saved from cuts to the training forces.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Jiangsu, and others applied savings from troop cuts to their training forces.

sentences.zh: 河南、山西、山東、湖南等省，則按直隸之法，於額兵內抽練，於正餉外略加練費。

translations.literal: Henan, Shanxi, Shandong, Hunan, and other provinces followed Zhili’s method, selecting and drilling from within quota troops, with a slight addition of drill pay beyond regular pay.
translations.idiomatic: Henan, Shanxi, Shandong, Hunan, and others followed Zhili by drilling men drawn from the regular rolls and adding modest training pay on top of base rations.

sentences.zh: 甘肅省則因軍事初定，先練千五百人。

translations.literal: Gansu province, because military affairs had just been settled, first drilled fifteen hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu, with fighting only just ended, began by drilling 1,500 men.

sentences.zh: 但各省所抽撥之兵，不過原額十之二三。

translations.literal: But troops selected and transferred in each province amounted to no more than two or three tenths of the original quota.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in each province only twenty or thirty percent of the original rolls were actually put under drill.

sentences.zh: 若其餘之兵，置之不問，終成疲弱。

translations.literal: If the remaining troops were left unattended, they would in the end become weak.
translations.idiomatic: The rest were left alone and inevitably grew slack.

sentences.zh: 應令各省統兵大臣，已練之兵，以時休息，其未練者，次第調操，期通省額兵咸成勁旅。

translations.literal: Each province’s commanding generals should be ordered: drilled troops should rest in rotation; undrilled troops should be transferred for drill in sequence, expecting that the whole province’s quota troops would all become crack forces.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial commanders should rotate rested drill cycles through the trained men and bring the untrained onto the drill ground in turn, until every soldier on the rolls became an effective fighter.

sentences.zh: 十三年，都興阿於奉天各城額兵內選練馬隊二千人，於各城八旗內選蘇拉千人為餘兵，俟客兵裁撤，再行增練。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Duxing’a selected and drilled two thousand cavalry from Fengtian’s garrison quota at each city, and chose one thousand sulah from each city’s Eight Banners as reserve troops; when guest troops were cut, further drilling would be added.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Duxing’a drilled 2,000 cavalry from Fengtian’s garrison rolls and 1,000 banner sulah as reserves in each city, planning further expansion once outside troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，崇實因奉天換防旗兵日久弊生，乃於岫岩、熊岳、大孤山、青堆子等處改設練軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu, Chong Shi, because long-rotated Fengtian banner garrisons had bred abuses over time, reestablished training forces at Xiuyan, Xiongyue, Dagushan, Qingduizi, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu, Chong Shi replaced worn-out rotating banner garrisons in Fengtian with training forces at Xiuyan, Xiongyue, Dagushan, Qingduizi, and other posts.

sentences.zh: 三年，允李慶翱之議，於河南省增設練軍步隊。

translations.literal: In the third year, Li Qing’ao’s proposal was approved to add training-force infantry in Henan province.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Li Qing’ao’s proposal was approved to add infantry to Henan’s training forces.

sentences.zh: 六年，令各疆臣酌量裁兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, frontier governors were ordered to cut troops as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year provincial governors were ordered to trim their establishments as they saw fit.

sentences.zh: 各省防軍自裁撤後，為數尚多。

translations.literal: After defense forces in each province were cut, their numbers were still large.
translations.idiomatic: Even after cuts, defense forces remained numerous in many provinces.

sentences.zh: 直隸、陝、甘須辦邊防，雲南、貴州則防軍較少，此外各省，均應大加裁汰。

translations.literal: Zhili, Shaanxi, and Gansu had to manage frontier defense; Yunnan and Guizhou had relatively fewer defense forces; all other provinces should make large cuts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili, Shaanxi, and Gansu still needed frontier troops; Yunnan and Guizhou already had relatively few defense forces; all other provinces should cut deeply.

sentences.zh: 水師自設兵輪船後，舊式戰船水師，亦分別去留。

translations.literal: After armed steamships were established for the navy, old-style war-junk naval forces were also selectively retained or removed.
translations.idiomatic: Once armed steamers entered service, the old war-junk fleets were also thinned or kept as needed.

sentences.zh: 旋廣西撫臣慶裕以廣西省兵單餉薄，乃酌裁防軍，以所節之餉，仿直隸練兵章程，在省標、提標內各選練二營，左右江兩鎮各選練一營。

translations.literal: Soon Guangxi Governor Qing Yu, because Guangxi’s troops were few and pay thin, suitably cut defense forces and, with the pay saved, imitating Zhili’s drill regulations, selected and drilled two battalions each within the provincial and commander’s banners, and one battalion each in the Zuojiang and Youjiang garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Guangxi’s Qing Yu, finding troops few and pay thin, cut defense forces and used the savings under Zhili’s drill rules to train two battalions each from the provincial and commander’s banners and one battalion each from the Zuojiang and Youjiang garrisons.

sentences.zh: 岐元以奉天省自同治間馬賊四齣肆擾，先後商調客軍，增練旗、綠各營，而營制餉章未能畫一。

translations.literal: Qi Yuan held that since the Tongzhi period horse bandits had raided in all directions in Fengtian, guest troops had been repeatedly requested and banner and Green Standard camps increased and drilled, yet camp systems and pay regulations could not be unified.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Yuan noted that since Tongzhi, horse bandits had ravaged Fengtian from every direction, prompting repeated calls for outside troops and expansion of banner and Green Standard camps, yet organization and pay remained inconsistent.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，乃以直隸客軍歸併奉天省，合槍砲馬步各隊，釐定營制，編為奉字中、左、右、前、後馬步隊五營，中軍增步隊一營。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu, Zhili guest troops were merged into Fengtian province; rifle, artillery, cavalry, and infantry units were combined; camp systems were fixed; organized as Feng-character center, left, right, front, and rear mixed cavalry-infantry five battalions, with the center army adding one infantry battalion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Guangxu, Zhili’s outside detachments were absorbed into Fengtian. Rifle, artillery, cavalry, and infantry units were unified into five Feng-designated mixed battalions — center, left, right, front, and rear — with an extra infantry battalion added to the center.

sentences.zh: 丁寶楨因四川省自軍興以後，川勇而外，益以湖南、貴州各軍，多至六萬餘人，事定次第裁併，至光緒三年，實存防軍一萬餘人，須分守要隘，未可再裁。

translations.literal: Ding Baozhen, because since Sichuan’s military rise, beyond Sichuan braves there were added Hunan and Guizhou armies, reaching over sixty thousand; after affairs settled they were cut and merged in sequence; by the third year of Guangxu there actually remained over ten thousand defense troops, who had to hold strategic passes and could not be cut further.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Baozhen explained that wartime Sichuan had swelled beyond local volunteers to include Hunan and Guizhou forces totaling more than 60,000 men. After peace, cuts proceeded in stages; by the third year of Guangxu about 10,000 defense troops remained holding vital passes and could not be reduced further.

sentences.zh: 貴州防軍，較他省為少，李明墀於光緒五年後，陸續裁汰四千餘人。

translations.literal: Guizhou’s defense forces were fewer than other provinces’; after the fifth year of Guangxu, Li Mingchi successively cut over four thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou already had fewer defense troops than most provinces; after the fifth year of Guangxu Li Mingchi cut more than 4,000 in stages.

sentences.zh: 李瀚章以湖北省防軍，若升字三營、忠義八營、武毅七營、水師七營，皆扼要駐守，不宜裁汰，就湖北通省額兵酌量裁去三千餘人。

translations.literal: Li Hanzhang held that Hubei’s defense forces — such as three Sheng-character battalions, eight Zhongyi battalions, seven Wuyi battalions, seven naval battalions — all held strategic posts and should not be cut; from Hubei’s whole-province quota troops about three thousand were suitably cut.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hanzhang argued that Hubei’s defense battalions — three Sheng units, eight Zhongyi, seven Wuyi, and seven naval — held critical posts and should stand, while about 3,000 men were cut from the provincial regular rolls instead.

sentences.zh: 裕祿以安徽省自捻寇平後，駐防皖南、皖北各軍，凡一萬八千餘人，次第歸併訓練，實存水陸防軍萬人。

translations.literal: Yulu held that in Anhui, after the Nian bandits were pacified, garrison forces in south and north Anhui totaled over eighteen thousand; they were merged and trained in sequence; actually ten thousand land and water defense troops remained.
translations.idiomatic: Yulu reported that after the Nian rebellion, Anhui’s 18,000-odd garrison troops in the south and north were gradually consolidated for training, leaving 10,000 land and river defense troops on the rolls.

sentences.zh: 七年，岑毓英因苗亂已平，貴州之屯軍、防勇，量為裁併，屯軍裁去九千人，以裁軍補額兵，酌改練軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Cen Yuying, because the Miao rebellion was pacified, suitably cut and merged Guizhou’s colony troops and defense braves; nine thousand colony troops were cut; cut troops filled regular quotas; training forces were suitably reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Cen Yuying, with the Miao rebellion over, trimmed Guizhou’s colony troops and defense volunteers, cutting 9,000 colony soldiers, filling regular quotas with the discharged men, and reorganizing training forces.

sentences.zh: 旋移撫福建，乃率貴州練軍二千人赴閩，教練閩省制兵。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to govern Fujian, he then led two thousand Guizhou training troops to Min and drilled Fujian’s regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: Soon transferred to Fujian, he took 2,000 Guizhou training troops with him to drill Fujian’s regulars.

sentences.zh: 譚鍾麟以浙江省防軍於光緒六年募足三十營，旋裁去四營，以練軍十營駐溫州，海門、省垣各一營，餘皆歸守汛地。

translations.literal: Tan Zhonglin held that Zhejiang’s defense forces in the sixth year of Guangxu were recruited to thirty battalions, then four battalions were cut; ten training battalions garrisoned Wenzhou; one each at Haimen and the provincial capital; the rest returned to garrison posts.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Zhonglin raised Zhejiang’s defense force to thirty battalions in the sixth year of Guangxu, then cut four; ten training battalions held Wenzhou, one each held Haimen and the provincial capital, and the rest returned to their garrison posts.

sentences.zh: 是年，以各省防軍歲餉甚鉅，令統兵大臣一律嚴核，不得有吞蝕空額諸弊。

translations.literal: That year, because each province’s defense-force annual pay was very large, commanding generals were ordered uniformly to audit strictly — there must be no abuses of embezzlement or phantom quotas.
translations.idiomatic: That year, with provincial defense payrolls enormous, field commanders were ordered to audit accounts strictly and root out embezzlement and ghost rolls.

sentences.zh: 八年，崇綺裁併奉天各軍，於八旗捷勝營及東邊道標兵、蒙古練勇外，所有馬步營中之南方防勇，遷地勿良，乃裁併為一營，餘悉遣歸原省。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Chong Qi cut and merged Fengtian’s various armies; apart from the Eight Banners’ Jiesheng camp, Eastern Frontier commissioner’s garrison troops, and Mongol drilled braves, all southern defense braves among cavalry and infantry camps — their transferred lands were not good — were cut and merged into one battalion; the rest were all sent back to their original provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Chong Qi consolidated Fengtian’s forces. Aside from the Jiesheng banner camp, the Eastern Frontier garrison, and Mongol drilled volunteers, southern defense volunteers in the cavalry and infantry — posted on poor land — were merged into one battalion and the rest sent home to their provinces.

sentences.zh: 任道鎔于山東省撫標及兗、曹鎮標內抽調步兵千二百人，分為三營，加餉訓練。

translations.literal: Ren Daorong in Shandong drew twelve hundred infantry from the governor’s banner and Yanzhou and Caozhou garrison banners, divided into three battalions, with added pay for training.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Daorong drew 1,200 infantry from Shandong’s governor’s banner and the Yanzhou and Caozhou garrisons into three battalions with extra pay for drill.

sentences.zh: 張曜、劉錦棠以伊犁收復，就關外營勇選練制兵，改行餉為坐糧，略更舊制，增馬隊重火器，設游擊之師，復參用屯田法，以足軍食。

translations.literal: Zhang Yao and Liu Jintang, as Yili was recovered, selected and drilled regular troops from frontier camps and braves, changed campaign pay to stationary grain rations, slightly altered the old system, increased cavalry and heavy weapons, established mobile strike forces, and again applied the military-colony method to supply army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: After Yili was recovered, Zhang Yao and Liu Jintang drilled regulars from frontier camps and volunteers, converted campaign pay to fixed rations, revised the old system, added cavalry and heavy weapons, created mobile strike columns, and used military farming to feed the troops.

sentences.zh: 九年，張之洞練山西省軍隊，由省標先練，掃除積習，為全省軍營模範。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Zhang Zhidong drilled Shanxi’s army, starting drill from the provincial banner, sweeping away accumulated abuses, as a model for the whole province’s military camps.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Zhang Zhidong reformed Shanxi’s army, beginning with the provincial banner to break old abuses and set the pattern for every camp in the province.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章裁撤直隸省防軍，除裁撤外，實存直字、榮字、義勝各營數千人，與淮軍之親兵及仁軍、盛軍、銘軍、楚軍等馬、步、水師三十九營，分防各地。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang cut Zhili’s defense forces; apart from those cut, there actually remained several thousand men in Zhi-character, Rong-character, and Yisheng battalions, together with the Huai Army’s personal guards and Ren, Sheng, Ming, Chu armies’ cavalry, infantry, and naval thirty-nine battalions, distributed for defense in various places.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang trimmed Zhili’s defense forces but still kept several thousand men in Zhi, Rong, and Yisheng battalions, together with thirty-nine cavalry, infantry, and naval battalions of Huai personal guards and Ren, Sheng, Ming, and Chu units posted across the province.

sentences.zh: 岑毓英以貴州苗疆多事，原設重兵數逾三萬，積久廢弛，專恃防軍定亂，事定後，以防軍歸入制兵。

translations.literal: Cen Yuying held that Guizhou’s Miao frontier had many troubles; originally heavy troops numbering over thirty thousand, neglected over time, relied solely on defense forces to settle disorder; after affairs were settled, defense forces were absorbed into regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Yuying explained that Guizhou’s turbulent Miao frontier had once fielded more than 30,000 troops, but long neglect left only the defense forces effective. After pacification, those defense units were folded into the regular establishment.

sentences.zh: 雲南省制兵，凡戰兵九千餘人，守兵七千餘人，塘汛堆卡，零星散布，而巡防緝捕，專任練軍，乃以戰兵屯聚於統將駐所，隨時整飭。

translations.literal: Yunnan’s regular troops: combat troops over nine thousand, garrison troops over seven thousand, scattered at posts, stockades, and checkpoints; patrol defense and arrest were solely the training forces’ duty; thus combat troops were massed at the commanding general’s station for timely rectification.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan’s regulars included more than 9,000 combat troops and 7,000 garrison troops scattered across posts and checkpoints, while patrol and pursuit fell to the training forces. Combat troops were therefore concentrated at headquarters for constant inspection.

sentences.zh: 潘霨裁併江西省防軍，實存七千八百餘人，每哨續裁十餘人，量為省並。

translations.literal: Pan Yi cut and merged Jiangxi’s defense forces; actually over seven thousand eight hundred remained; each platoon continued to cut over ten men, suitably consolidated to save.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Yi consolidated Jiangxi’s defense forces to about 7,800 men, trimming more than ten soldiers from each platoon where consolidation allowed.

sentences.zh: 曾國荃綜核廣東省募兵之數，於光緒六年，張之洞曾募沙民千人守虎門，楊玉科增募千人及惠清營五百人，鄭紹忠募安勇二千人，八年，募勁勇千人駐欽州，鄧安邦續募千人，散布廣州各屬，其廣東額兵實存九千餘人。

translations.literal: Zeng Guoquan audited Guangdong’s recruited troop numbers: in the sixth year of Guangxu, Zhang Zhidong had recruited one thousand sand people to guard Humen; Yang Yukuo added one thousand recruits and five hundred for the Huiqing camp; Zheng Shaozhong recruited two thousand An braves; in the eighth year, one thousand elite braves were recruited to garrison Qinzhou; Deng Anbang continued recruiting one thousand, distributed through Guangzhou’s dependencies; Guangdong’s quota troops actually numbered over nine thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guoquan tallied Guangdong’s recruitment: in the sixth year of Guangxu Zhang Zhidong raised 1,000 sand fishermen for Humen; Yang Yukuo added 1,000 men and 500 for the Huiqing camp; Zheng Shaozhong raised 2,000 An volunteers; in the eighth year 1,000 elite troops garrisoned Qinzhou; Deng Anbang raised another 1,000 posted through Guangzhou’s dependencies — while Guangdong’s regular rolls still held more than 9,000 men.

sentences.zh: 十年，奎斌裁汰山西省兩鎮兵三千餘人，挑練大同鎮馬步隊各一營，太原鎮步隊一營。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Kuibin cut over three thousand troops from Shanxi’s two garrisons, selecting and drilling one cavalry-infantry battalion each at Datong garrison and one infantry battalion at Taiyuan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Kuibin cut more than 3,000 men from Shanxi’s two regional commands and drilled one mixed cavalry-infantry battalion at Datong and one infantry battalion at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，卞寶第裁湖南省綠營，選精壯為練軍，給以雙餉，其未足之額，以營勇補之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Bian Baodi cut Hunan’s Green Standard [forces], selected the elite for training forces, gave double pay; shortfalls in quota were filled with camp braves.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Bian Baodi cut Hunan’s Green Standard rolls, picked the fit for training forces at double pay, and filled gaps with camp volunteers.

sentences.zh: 希元等抽撥吉林防軍左右路馬步營千五百人，又於未練之兵及八旗台站西丹內選三千人，編為吉字營，分左右二翼，修築壁壘，歸營訓練。

translations.literal: Xiyuan and others transferred fifteen hundred from Jilin defense forces’ left and right route cavalry-infantry camps; furthermore from undrilled troops and Eight Banner station xidan, three thousand were chosen, organized as Ji-character camps in left and right wings, built fortifications, and returned to camp for training.
translations.idiomatic: Xiyuan and others drew 1,500 men from Jilin’s left and right defense cavalry-infantry camps, selected another 3,000 from untrained troops and banner station xidan, organized them into Ji-designated left and right wings, built fortifications, and put them under camp drill.

sentences.zh: 岑毓英以雲南省沿邊之防軍一萬六千人分編三十營，於每年瘴消之際，親歷邊疆，巡視防務。

translations.literal: Cen Yuying had Yunnan’s sixteen thousand frontier defense troops divided into thirty battalions; at the season when miasma cleared each year, he personally toured the frontier to inspect defense duties.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Yuying organized Yunnan’s 16,000 frontier defense troops into thirty battalions and each year, when the malarial season ended, toured the border himself to inspect the garrisons.

sentences.zh: 卞寶第分湖南全額兵之半，加以訓練，編為巡防營。

translations.literal: Bian Baodi took half of Hunan’s whole quota troops, gave them training, and organized them as patrol-defense battalions.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Baodi put half of Hunan’s entire regular establishment under training and organized them as patrol garrisons.

sentences.zh: 十二年，劉秉璋以四川省防營漸染習氣，所有壽字、武字等十營，巡鹽五營，一律選練整飭。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Liu Bingzhang held that Sichuan’s defense camps had gradually taken on bad habits; all ten battalions such as the Shou-character and Wu-character units, together with five salt-patrol battalions, were uniformly selected, drilled, and rectified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Liu Bingzhang found that Sichuan’s defense camps had grown slack with old abuses, and had every one of the ten Shou- and Wu-designated battalions plus five salt-patrol battalions selected, re-drilled, and brought back into order.

sentences.zh: 十三年，穆圖善整理東三省練兵事宜，每省挑練馬隊二起，步隊八營，奉天、吉林、黑龍江各足成四千五百人，以克魯伯砲六十尊，分配三省防營。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Mutushan put in order the Three Eastern Provinces’ troop-drilling affairs; each province selected and drilled two cavalry detachments and eight infantry battalions; Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang each fully made up 4,500 men; sixty Krupp guns were distributed among the three provinces’ defense camps.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Mutushan reorganized drilling in the Three Eastern Provinces, raising two cavalry detachments and eight infantry battalions per province so that Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang each fielded 4,500 men, and distributing sixty Krupp guns among their defense camps.

sentences.zh: 剛毅裁併山西省額兵六千人，就餉練兵，撫標馬隊一旗，步隊三營，太原鎮馬隊二旗，步隊四營，大同鎮馬隊七旗，步隊二營，編列成軍，其北路則以樹字各營分地巡防。

translations.literal: Gangyi cut and merged six thousand quota troops of Shanxi and, from their pay, drilled troops: one banner of provincial cavalry and three infantry battalions; at Taiyuan garrison two cavalry banners and four infantry battalions; at Datong garrison seven cavalry banners and two infantry battalions, organized into army units; on the northern route, Shu-character battalions were assigned by district for patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: Gangyi cut 6,000 men from Shanxi’s rolls and used the savings to drill new units: one provincial cavalry banner and three infantry battalions; two cavalry banners and four infantry battalions at Taiyuan; seven cavalry banners and two infantry battalions at Datong. On the northern route, Shu-designated battalions took up district patrol duties.

sentences.zh: 十四年，岑毓英就雲南省內地防軍及邊關勇營內共選練九千六百餘人，以符通省戰兵五成之數。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Cen Yuying selected and drilled over nine thousand six hundred men from Yunnan’s interior defense forces and frontier volunteer camps, to match the province-wide quota of fifty percent combat troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Cen Yuying picked and drilled more than 9,600 men from Yunnan’s interior defense forces and frontier volunteer camps to meet the provincial target of keeping half the force as combat troops.

sentences.zh: 而邊境遼闊，分防尚屬不敷，乃增練三十營，凡一萬五千四百餘人，分防騰越、蒙自各邊及大理、普洱各府。

translations.literal: But the frontier was vast and distributed defense was still insufficient; therefore thirty battalions were added, totaling over fifteen thousand four hundred men, distributed to defend the Tengyue and Mengzi frontiers and the prefectures of Dali and Pu’er.
translations.idiomatic: The border was too wide for the existing garrisons, so thirty more battalions—more than 15,400 men—were drilled and posted along the Tengyue and Mengzi frontiers and in Dali and Pu’er.

sentences.zh: 十五年，譚鈞培更定雲南省營制。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Tan Junpei revised Yunnan’s camp organization.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Tan Junpei overhauled Yunnan’s camp organization.

sentences.zh: 雲南防軍，於光緒二年，劉長佑挑練戰兵，以三百七十人編為一營。

translations.literal: Yunnan’s defense forces: in the second year of Guangxu, Liu Changyou selected and drilled combat troops, organizing three hundred seventy men as one battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan’s defense forces dated their reorganization to the second year of Guangxu, when Liu Changyou picked combat troops and formed battalions of 370 men each.

sentences.zh: 十年，岑毓英以督師出關，改編二百二十人為一小營，營分五哨，哨各四隊，隊各十人。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Cen Yuying as commanding general went beyond the passes and reorganized two hundred twenty men as one small battalion; each battalion was divided into five platoons, each platoon into four squads, each squad ten men.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, when Cen Yuying led the army beyond the passes, he reorganized units into small battalions of 220 men, each divided into five platoons of four ten-man squads.

sentences.zh: 十一年，合練軍各營，以半防內地，半防邊境，仍以二百人上下為一小營。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, training force battalions were consolidated; half defended the interior and half the frontier, still with roughly two hundred men as one small battalion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the training force battalions were merged so that half garrisoned the interior and half the frontier, still at roughly 200 men per small battalion.

sentences.zh: 凡調防八成戰兵七十七營，留防粵勇十二營，裸黑防勇六營，西南土防二十五營。

translations.literal: In all there were seventy-seven battalions of combat troops at eighty percent strength for transferred defense; twelve Guangdong volunteer battalions retained on defense; six Luohé frontier volunteer battalions; and twenty-five southwestern native defense battalions.
translations.idiomatic: The force comprised seventy-seven combat battalions at eighty percent strength for rotation, twelve retained Guangdong volunteer battalions, six Luohé frontier volunteer battalions, and twenty-five southwestern native defense battalions.

sentences.zh: 乃裁汰三成，歸併整齊，以三營為一營，每營分編五哨，中哨六隊，餘各三隊，以散合整。

translations.literal: Then thirty percent were cut, merged, and ordered; three battalions became one; each battalion was divided into five platoons, the center platoon six squads and the others three each, combining scattered units into order.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty percent were then cut and the remainder consolidated: three old battalions became one, each reorganized into five platoons—the center with six squads, the rest with three—turning scattered units into a coherent whole.

sentences.zh: 凡戰兵二十六營，粵勇五營，裸黑勇二營，土勇十三營。

translations.literal: In all there were twenty-six combat battalions, five Guangdong volunteer battalions, two Luohé volunteer battalions, and thirteen native volunteer battalions.
translations.idiomatic: The result was twenty-six combat battalions, five Guangdong volunteer battalions, two Luohé volunteer battalions, and thirteen native volunteer battalions.

sentences.zh: 十六年，張曜練山東省步隊一營。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Zhang Yao drilled one infantry battalion in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Zhang Yao drilled one infantry battalion in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十七年，福潤增練步隊左營。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Furun added drill of the Left Infantry Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Furun added a Left Infantry Battalion to the drill program.

sentences.zh: 鹿傳霖以陝西省自經亂後，兵制未復，乃酌留馬步防軍並練軍各營，居中策應，各路馬隊，利於巡緝，乃改步隊為馬隊以節餉糈，凡防、練軍馬隊千五百人，在平原及北山扼要駐守。

translations.literal: Lu Chuanlin held that since the disorders in Shaanxi, military organization had not been restored; he therefore retained defense and training force battalions of cavalry and infantry for central support; cavalry on the various routes was suited to patrol and pursuit, so infantry was changed to cavalry to save rations; in all fifteen hundred cavalry from the defense and training forces garrisoned strategic points on the plains and in the northern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Chuanlin explained that Shaanxi’s military system had not recovered from the recent troubles, so he kept selected defense and training battalions in the center for rapid response. Because cavalry patrolled more effectively, he converted infantry to cavalry to save pay, posting 1,500 mounted defense and training troops at key points on the plains and northern hills.

sentences.zh: 張煦以湖南省自湘勇回籍後，專恃防軍彈壓各路，凡防軍萬人，水勇二千四百餘人，乃歸併損益，互為聲援。

translations.literal: Zhang Xu held that since the Xiang volunteers had returned home, Hunan relied solely on defense forces to suppress the various routes; there were ten thousand defense troops and over two thousand four hundred naval volunteers; he merged and adjusted them for mutual support.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xu noted that after the Xiang volunteers went home, Hunan depended entirely on 10,000 defense troops and more than 2,400 naval volunteers to hold the province; he consolidated and rebalanced them so they could support one another.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，依克唐阿編定奉天省砲兵三哨，合原有之防軍為五營，又以效力獵戶二千人編為四營。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Yiketanga organized Fengtian’s three artillery platoons, combined them with the original defense forces as five battalions, and organized two thousand effective hunter households into four battalions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Yiketanga formed three artillery platoons in Fengtian, merged them with existing defense units into five battalions, and enrolled 2,000 hunter households as four battalions.

sentences.zh: 是年張之洞創練自強軍十三營於江南，器械訓練，悉仿歐洲。

translations.literal: That year Zhang Zhidong founded and drilled thirteen Self-Strengthening Army battalions in Jiangnan; weapons and training all imitated Europe.
translations.idiomatic: That same year Zhang Zhidong raised thirteen Self-Strengthening Army battalions in Jiangnan, equipping and training them entirely on the European model.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，張之洞練洋操隊二營於湖北。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, Zhang Zhidong drilled two Western drill battalions in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Zhang Zhidong drilled two Western drill battalions in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 聶士成於直隸駐防淮軍內選練馬步隊三十營，仿德國營制操法，編為武毅軍。

translations.literal: Nie Shicheng, within the Huai Army garrisoned in Zhili, selected and drilled thirty cavalry and infantry battalions, imitating German camp organization and drill methods, and organized them as the Wu Yi Army.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Shicheng picked thirty cavalry and infantry battalions from the Huai Army garrison in Zhili, trained them on the German model, and organized them as the Wu Yi Army.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，張之洞以練軍重在操演，令分防各營，以十之一更番來省，教以新操，俟練成後，轉授各營。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Zhang Zhidong held that training forces’ chief concern was drill exercise; he ordered garrison battalions to send one-tenth in rotation to the provincial capital to be taught the new drill, and after they were trained, to teach it back to each battalion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Zhang Zhidong argued that training forces lived or died by drill, and ordered each garrison to send one man in ten in rotation to the provincial capital for the new drill, then back to train the rest.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，王毓藻練貴州軍隊，先就省防三營改習洋操，次第推及各營。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Wang Yuzao drilled Guizhou’s army; first three provincial defense battalions were made to adopt Western drill, then the reform was extended in turn to all battalions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Wang Yuzao reformed Guizhou’s army, starting with three provincial defense battalions on Western drill and extending the change battalion by battalion.

sentences.zh: 王文韶挑留直隸全省淮、練各軍二萬餘人，編為二十營，分左右翼，駐守大沽口及山海關，以練軍三十三營分防內地及熱河等處。

translations.literal: Wang Wenshao selected and retained over twenty thousand Huai and training troops in all Zhili, organized them into twenty battalions in left and right wings garrisoned at Dagu and Shanhaiguan, and distributed thirty-three training battalions for defense of the interior and Rehe and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wenshao kept more than 20,000 Huai and training troops in Zhili, formed twenty left- and right-wing battalions at Dagu and Shanhaiguan, and posted thirty-three training battalions across the interior and Rehe.

sentences.zh: 色楞額以熱河兼轄蒙古兩盟十七旗，而馬步防兵僅有千人，乃增練壯丁五百人為一營，馬隊五百人為二營，佐以砲隊百人。

translations.literal: Seleng’e held that Rehe also governed two Mongol leagues and seventeen banners, yet cavalry and infantry defense troops numbered only one thousand; he therefore added drill of five hundred able-bodied men as one battalion, five hundred cavalry as two battalions, assisted by a one-hundred-man artillery unit.
translations.idiomatic: Seleng’e pointed out that Rehe governed two Mongol leagues and seventeen banners but had only 1,000 defense troops, so he added one 500-man infantry battalion, two 250-man cavalry battalions, and a 100-man artillery detachment.

sentences.zh: 增祺以福建省多山，新練防軍，宜重步隊，參以砲隊，增制過山快砲十二尊。

translations.literal: Zeng Qi held that Fujian was mountainous; newly drilled defense forces should emphasize infantry with artillery support; twelve mountain quick-firing guns were added.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Qi argued that Fujian’s terrain called for infantry-heavy newly drilled defense forces backed by artillery, and added twelve mountain quick-firing guns.

sentences.zh: 胡聘之以東、直、秦、豫各省皆有防軍，支餉自數十萬至百萬不等，而山西省屏蔽畿疆，僅有練軍五千人，乃增練新軍，固西路之防。

translations.literal: Hu Pinyi noted that the eastern provinces, Zhili, Shaanxi, and Henan all had defense forces with pay ranging from several hundred thousand to a million taels; Shanxi, shielding the capital region, had only five thousand training forces; he therefore added drill of a new army to strengthen the western defense.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Pinyi observed that eastern provinces, Zhili, Shaanxi, and Henan all maintained defense forces costing from hundreds of thousands to a million taels, while Shanxi— guarding the capital’s western flank—had only 5,000 training troops; he therefore raised a new army to secure the western approaches.

sentences.zh: 榮祿因北洋四大軍訓練已成，分路駐防，以武毅軍駐蘆台為前軍，甘軍駐薊州為後軍，毅軍駐山海關為左軍，新建軍駐小站為右軍，別練萬人駐南苑為中軍，軍械不足，令江南機器局撥解新式快槍三千枝，快砲七尊，原有之淮軍一萬二千人，防、練軍一萬九千人，歸併訓練。

translations.literal: Ronglu, because training of the Northern Four Armies was complete, distributed them for garrison: the Wu Yi Army at Lutai as the Front Army, the Gan Army at Jizhou as the Rear Army, the Yi Army at Shanhaiguan as the Left Army, and the New Army at Xiaozhan as the Right Army; separately ten thousand men were drilled and garrisoned at Nanyuan as the Central Army; weapons were insufficient, so the Jiangnan Arsenal was ordered to supply three thousand new quick-firing rifles and seven quick-firing guns; the original twelve thousand Huai Army and nineteen thousand defense and training forces were merged for training.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Northern Four Armies were trained, Ronglu posted them as the Front Army at Lutai (Wu Yi), Rear Army at Jizhou (Gan), Left Army at Shanhaiguan (Yi), and Right Army at Xiaozhan (New Army), with 10,000 more at Nanyuan as the Central Army. Short of arms, he ordered 3,000 quick-firing rifles and seven quick-firing guns from the Jiangnan Arsenal and merged the existing 12,000 Huai troops and 19,000 defense and training forces into the new program.

sentences.zh: 劉坤一以江南省之江寧、鎮江、吳淞、江陰、徐州五路防軍悉改習洋操，所用軍械，統歸一律。

translations.literal: Liu Kunyi had Jiangnan’s five-route defense forces at Jiangning, Zhenjiang, Wusong, Jiangyin, and Xuzhou all adopt Western drill, and their weapons were uniformly standardized.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kunyi put Jiangnan’s five defense routes—Jiangning, Zhenjiang, Wusong, Jiangyin, and Xuzhou—on Western drill and standardized their weapons throughout.

sentences.zh: 是年，令王大臣選京師神機營馬步萬人為選鋒營。

translations.literal: That year, princes and ministers were ordered to select ten thousand cavalry and infantry from the Beijing Shenji Camp as the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: That year the court ordered princes and ministers to pick 10,000 cavalry and infantry from Beijing’s Shenji Camp to form the Vanguard Camp.

sentences.zh: 令北方各省營伍，由新建軍遣員教習，南方各省營伍，由自強軍遣員教習。

translations.literal: Northern provincial camps were to be instructed by men dispatched from the New Army; southern provincial camps by men dispatched from the Self-Strengthening Army.
translations.idiomatic: Northern provincial units were to be drilled by instructors from the New Army; southern units by instructors from the Self-Strengthening Army.

sentences.zh: 東三省防練各營伍，由北洋武備學堂遣人教習。

translations.literal: Defense and training camps in the Three Eastern Provinces were to be instructed by men dispatched from the Beiyang Military Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Defense and training units in the Three Eastern Provinces were to be drilled by instructors from the Beiyang Military Academy.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，李秉衡上言奉天仁、育二軍，訓練已成，應擇地修築營壘，俾成重鎮。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Li Bingheng memorialized that the Ren and Yu armies of Fengtian had finished training and that sites should be chosen to build fortifications so they could become strongholds.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Li Bingheng reported that Fengtian’s Ren and Yu armies were fully trained and urged that fortifications be built at chosen sites to turn them into major garrisons.

sentences.zh: 裕祿以直隸防、練各軍為數太多，乃挑留馬步精兵一萬八百餘人，編為練軍步隊十二營，馬隊二十營，更定營制，步隊以三百人為一營，馬隊以二百餘人為一營，凡三十二營，分為直隸練軍左右翼，以通永鎮總兵統左翼，天津鎮總兵統右翼，其新建等軍，仍與宋慶之二十五營各守原防。

translations.literal: Yulu held that Zhili’s defense and training forces were too numerous; he therefore selected and retained over ten thousand eight hundred elite cavalry and infantry, organized them into twelve training infantry battalions and twenty cavalry battalions, revised the camp organization with three hundred men per infantry battalion and over two hundred per cavalry battalion—thirty-two battalions in all—divided into left and right wings of Zhili training forces, the left wing commanded by the Tongzhou-Yongding garrison commander and the right by the Tianjin garrison commander; the New Army and other units, together with Song Qing’s twenty-five battalions, still held their original posts.
translations.idiomatic: Yulu found Zhili’s defense and training forces too large, kept 10,800 picked cavalry and infantry, and reorganized them into twelve infantry battalions of 300 men and twenty cavalry battalions of roughly 200—thirty-two battalions under left and right Zhili training wings commanded from Tongzhou-Yongding and Tianjin. The New Army and Song Qing’s twenty-five battalions remained at their old posts.

sentences.zh: 劉樹堂以浙江防軍雲字、吉字、勝字、旅字各營凡十一營二十三旗，並為五軍，名為兩浙新軍，用北洋武毅軍操法訓練。

translations.literal: Liu Shutang merged Zhejiang’s Yun-character, Ji-character, Sheng-character, and Lü-character defense battalions—eleven battalions and twenty-three banners in all—into five armies named the Liang-Zhe New Army, trained by the Beiyang Wu Yi Army drill methods.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shutang consolidated Zhejiang’s eleven Yun-, Ji-, Sheng-, and Lü-designated battalions and twenty-three banners into five armies called the Liang-Zhe New Army, drilled on the Beiyang Wu Yi model.

sentences.zh: 松壽以江西省防軍有忠新等營二千餘人，內江及贛防水師二千四百餘人，武威等營旗三千餘人，分佈各路，乃在省城設全省營務處，為訓練各軍之總匯。

translations.literal: Song Shou noted that Jiangxi’s defense forces included over two thousand men in Zhongxin and other battalions, over two thousand four hundred river-defense sailors on the Neijiang and Gan rivers, and over three thousand in Wuwei and other battalions and banners, distributed on various routes; he therefore established a provincial camp affairs office in the capital as the central hub for training all armies.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shou counted more than 2,000 men in Jiangxi’s Zhongxin and related defense battalions, 2,400 river-defense sailors on the Neijiang and Gan, and 3,000 in Wuwei and allied units scattered across the province, and set up a provincial camp affairs office in the capital to coordinate their training.

sentences.zh: 劉坤一以江南各軍歸併為三十七營，加以新法教練，漸有成效。

translations.literal: Liu Kunyi merged Jiangnan’s various armies into thirty-seven battalions, added new-method instruction, and gradually achieved results.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kunyi consolidated Jiangnan’s forces into thirty-seven battalions, put them on the new drill, and began to see steady improvement.

sentences.zh: 文興以盛京八旗制兵，汰弱留強，仿北洋練軍新法教練。

translations.literal: Wen Xing had the regular troops of the Eight Banners at Mukden cut the weak and keep the strong, and drilled them by the new methods of the Beiyang training forces.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Xing trimmed Mukden’s banner regulars to the fit and drilled them on the Beiyang training-force model.

sentences.zh: 裕祥就四川駐防旗兵內選精銳為一營，陣法營制，與防軍一式。

translations.literal: Yu Xiang selected elites from the garrison banner troops in Sichuan as one battalion; battle formation and camp organization matched the defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xiang picked an elite battalion from Sichuan’s garrison banner troops, using the same formations and organization as the defense forces.

sentences.zh: 松壽以江西省新練防軍三千人，撥解南北洋新式槍砲，以資操練。

translations.literal: Song Shou had three thousand newly drilled defense troops in Jiangxi supplied with new-style rifles and guns from the Northern and Southern arsenals for drill practice.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shou armed Jiangxi’s 3,000 newly drilled defense troops with modern rifles and guns from the northern and southern arsenals for training.

sentences.zh: 黃槐森選廣西省各軍，先就省標、提標及左右江各營挑練一千四百人，為各軍模範。

translations.literal: Huang Huaisen selected Guangxi’s various armies; first from the provincial banner, the commander’s banner, and battalions of the Left and Right Rivers he picked and drilled fourteen hundred men as a model for all armies.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Huaisen began reforming Guangxi’s forces by drilling 1,400 men from the provincial and command banners and Left and Right River battalions as a model for the rest.

sentences.zh: 廖壽豐以浙江省寧波、鎮海各營次第改習洋操，省防各軍先練步隊三哨，砲隊一哨，凡標營及防、練軍，俟四哨教成，更番改練，推及全省。

translations.literal: Liao Shoufeng had Zhejiang’s Ningbo and Zhenhai battalions adopt Western drill in turn; provincial defense forces first drilled three infantry platoons and one artillery platoon; all banner camps and defense and training forces, once the four platoons were trained, would rotate through re-drill and extend the reform to the whole province.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Shoufeng put Ningbo and Zhenhai on Western drill first, then trained three infantry platoons and one artillery platoon as a provincial model; banner, defense, and training units would rotate through those four platoons until the whole province was converted.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，端方以陝西新練洋操之馬步十三旗，分防南北山隘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Duanfang had Shaanxi’s thirteen newly drilled Western-drill cavalry and infantry banners distributed to defend the mountain passes of the northern and southern ranges.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Duanfang posted Shaanxi’s thirteen newly drilled Western-drill cavalry and infantry banners at mountain passes north and south.

sentences.zh: 是年，令各省疆臣嚴定將弁貪墨之刑，並整理浙江省防營積弊。

translations.literal: That year, provincial governors-general were ordered to impose strict penalties on corrupt officers and to rectify accumulated abuses in Zhejiang’s defense camps.
translations.idiomatic: That year the court ordered governors to crack down on corrupt officers and clean up long-standing abuses in Zhejiang’s defense camps.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，李興銳以江西防軍人數不一，乃分為五路，釐定人數，以中軍為常備軍，前、後、左、右軍為續備軍，軍各五營，營各五哨。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Li Xingrui held that Jiangxi’s defense forces had uneven numbers; he therefore divided them into five routes, fixed the numbers, made the Central Army the standing forces and the Front, Rear, Left, and Right armies the reserve forces—each army five battalions, each battalion five platoons.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Li Xingrui standardized Jiangxi’s uneven defense rolls by dividing them into five routes: a Central standing force and Front, Rear, Left, and Right reserve forces of five battalions and five platoons each.

sentences.zh: 劉坤一以江南武衛先鋒軍、江勝軍各二千人為常備左右軍，其餘防軍四十餘營悉編為續備軍。

translations.literal: Liu Kunyi made the Jiangnan Wuwei Vanguard Army and the Jiangsheng Army, two thousand men each, the left and right standing forces; all remaining defense forces of over forty battalions were reorganized as reserve forces.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kunyi designated the 2,000-man Wuwei Vanguard and Jiangsheng armies as left and right standing forces and folded the remaining forty-plus defense battalions into the reserve.

sentences.zh: 岑春煊以山西省兵制紛歧，有練軍、防軍、晉威軍之判，乃仿北洋武衛軍制，以省標三千人分左右翼為常備軍，以太原、大同二鎮兵共練三千人為續備軍。

translations.literal: Cen Chunxuan held that Shanxi’s military organization was confused, with distinctions among training forces, defense forces, and the Jinwei Army; he therefore imitated the Beiyang Wuwei Army system, making three thousand provincial banner troops in left and right wings the standing forces and three thousand drilled troops of the Taiyuan and Datong garrisons the reserve forces.
