translations.idiomatic: Cen Chunxuan found Shanxi’s forces split among training troops, defense troops, and the Jinwei Army, and modeled a new scheme on the Beiyang Wuwei system: 3,000 provincial banner troops as left and right standing forces and 3,000 drilled men from Taiyuan and Datong as reserves.

sentences.zh: 魏光燾以雲南省防軍二十四營，營各二百五十人，改編為常備軍十二營，營各三百人，舊有練軍改為續備軍，均練習洋操。

translations.literal: Wei Guangtao reorganized Yunnan’s twenty-four defense battalions of two hundred fifty men each into twelve standing battalions of three hundred men each; the old training forces became reserve forces; all practiced Western drill.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Guangtao converted Yunnan’s twenty-four 250-man defense battalions into twelve 300-man standing battalions, turned the old training forces into reserves, and put all on Western drill.

sentences.zh: 丁振鐸於廣西省防軍三營內選千人為常備軍，各屬防軍，就人數多寡，練一、二隊不等。

translations.literal: Ding Zhenduo selected one thousand men from Guangxi’s three defense battalions as standing forces; each subordinate defense unit, according to its numbers, drilled one or two squads as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Zhenduo picked 1,000 men from Guangxi’s three defense battalions as standing forces, with each subordinate unit drilling one or two squads according to its size.

sentences.zh: 鄧華熙以貴州防軍及威遠營並練五營，凡千五百人，為常備軍，東西路練軍及緝捕營共二十九營，選練五千七百人，為續備軍，分防各隘。

translations.literal: Deng Huaxi made Guizhou’s defense forces and the Weiyuan camp, together with five drilled battalions totaling fifteen hundred men, the standing forces; twenty-nine battalions of eastern and western route training forces and pursuit camps, with five thousand seven hundred selected and drilled, became reserve forces distributed to defend the various passes.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Huaxi formed a 1,500-man standing force from Guizhou’s defense troops, the Weiyuan camp, and five drilled battalions, and a 5,700-man reserve from twenty-nine eastern and western training and pursuit battalions posted at the passes.

sentences.zh: 是年，設軍政司於天津，總司直隸省淮、練各防軍操防事宜。

translations.literal: That year, a Military Administration Bureau was established at Tianjin to oversee drill and defense affairs of Zhili’s Huai, training, and defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: That year a Military Administration Bureau was set up at Tianjin to supervise drill and garrison duties for all Huai, training, and defense forces in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，升允以陝西省新舊各軍均已改習洋操，乃選精銳六旗為常備新軍，其忠靖八旗兩翼步隊，武威兩翼馬隊，改為步隊十二旗，以六旗為續備防軍，六旗為續備長軍，防軍有地方之責，長軍為開荒之需，以馬隊砲隊佐之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Sheng Yun held that Shaanxi’s old and new armies had all adopted Western drill; he therefore selected six elite banners as the standing new army; the Zhongjing Eight Banners’ two-wing infantry and the Wuwei two-wing cavalry were reorganized into twelve infantry banners—six banners as reserve defense forces and six as reserve Chang forces; defense forces bore local responsibilities, Chang forces served land-reclamation needs, assisted by cavalry and artillery units.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Sheng Yun, with all Shaanxi’s old and new units on Western drill, picked six elite banners as a standing new army and reorganized the Zhongjing banner infantry and Wuwei cavalry into twelve infantry banners—six as reserve defense troops for local duty and six as reserve Chang troops for frontier reclamation, backed by cavalry and artillery.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，夏時以江西省新軍僅有千二百人，江防重要，殊苦不足，九江為全省門戶，乃別募一軍，亦為常備軍，合中、前常備兩軍共十營，專防省城及九江二處，以左、右、後續備三軍分防各地。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Xia Shi held that Jiangxi’s new army numbered only twelve hundred men and river defense was critically important yet sorely insufficient; Jiujiang was the province’s gateway; he therefore separately recruited another army, also as standing forces; together with the Central and Front standing armies there were ten battalions devoted to defending the provincial capital and Jiujiang, while the Left, Right, and Rear reserve armies were distributed to defend various places.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Xia Shi found Jiangxi’s 1,200-man new army too small for vital river defense, and since Jiujiang guarded the provincial gateway he raised another standing army. With the Central and Front standing forces, ten battalions now held the capital and Jiujiang while Left, Right, and Rear reserves covered the rest of the province.

sentences.zh: 三十年，曹鴻勛以貴州各軍於光緒二十六年改編為常備軍、續備軍，共二十四營，嗣因沿邊戒嚴，增募防勇十九營，而籌餉艱難，遂每營酌減人數，凡防、練軍及親兵減存一萬五百餘人，次第改習洋操。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Cao Hongxun noted that Guizhou’s various armies had been reorganized in the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu into standing and reserve forces totaling twenty-four battalions; afterward, because of frontier alert, nineteen defense volunteer battalions were added; but raising pay was difficult, so each battalion’s numbers were suitably reduced; in all defense and training forces and personal guards were cut to over ten thousand five hundred men, who were then converted to Western drill in turn.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Cao Hongxun reported that Guizhou’s twenty-four standing and reserve battalions of 1900 had swelled by nineteen frontier volunteer battalions during border alerts, but pay was tight so each unit was trimmed until defense, training, and personal guards totaled just over 10,500 men, who were then put on Western drill one by one.

sentences.zh: 潘效蘇於新疆標、防、巡、練各軍三萬二千餘人內，選存正勇一萬三千餘人，於南北各路勺配分防。

translations.literal: Pan Xiaosu, from over thirty-two thousand men in Xinjiang’s banner, defense, patrol, and training forces, selected and retained over thirteen thousand regular braves, proportionally distributed for defense on the northern and southern routes.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Xiaosu cut Xinjiang’s 32,000 banner, defense, patrol, and training troops to 13,000 picked regulars and distributed them proportionally along the northern and southern routes.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，練兵處王大臣以山東省武衛先鋒隊二十營分防散漫，令擇地屯駐，增募成鎮。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the princes and ministers of the Army Training Office held that Shandong’s twenty Wuwei Vanguard battalions were scattered in defense; they ordered sites chosen for concentrated garrison and additional recruitment to form a full brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the Army Training Office found Shandong’s twenty Wuwei Vanguard battalions too scattered and ordered them concentrated at chosen posts and expanded into a full brigade.

sentences.zh: 是年，命鐵良校閱江蘇、安徽、江西、湖北各省防軍、練軍、陸軍、旗兵、巡警兵。

translations.literal: That year, Tie Liang was ordered to inspect the defense forces, training forces, Army, banner troops, and constabulary of Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tie Liang was sent to inspect defense forces, training forces, Army units, banner troops, and constabulary in Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 鐵良遍閱各軍，大都軍械不一，操法亦未盡嫺，舊營改練，進步甚遲。

translations.literal: Tie Liang inspected all the armies in turn; for the most part their weapons were not uniform, drill methods were not fully proficient, and old camps converted to drill made very slow progress.
translations.idiomatic: Tie Liang toured every unit and found weapons still mixed, drill uneven, and converted old camps advancing painfully slowly.

sentences.zh: 惟安徽練軍二隊，九江常備五營，湖北二鎮，較為生色。

translations.literal: Only Anhui’s two training force squads, Jiujiang’s five standing battalions, and Hubei’s two garrisons were somewhat more presentable.
translations.idiomatic: Only Anhui’s two training squads, Jiujiang’s five standing battalions, and Hubei’s two regional commands looked noticeably better.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，張之洞以沿江督捕營、下游緝匪營改編為水陸巡緝隊。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, Zhang Zhidong reorganized the river-bank pursuit camps and downstream bandit-suppression camps as a joint land-and-water patrol corps.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year Zhang Zhidong converted the river-bank pursuit camps and downstream bandit-suppression camps into a combined land-and-water patrol corps.

sentences.zh: 王士珍以江北巡防隊改為步隊六營，馬隊二營，其餘淮海水師、練軍衛隊，悉仍其舊。

translations.literal: Wang Shizhen reorganized the northern Jiangsu patrol garrisons into six infantry battalions and two cavalry battalions; the rest—the Huai-Hai naval force and training force guards—remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shizhen converted northern Jiangsu’s patrol garrisons into six infantry and two cavalry battalions while leaving the Huai-Hai naval force and training guards unchanged.

sentences.zh: 錫良以雲南防軍二十七營，鐵路巡防十一營，土勇一營，凡三十九營，次第改編新軍，以全省防軍每營二百五十人為定額，分南防、西防、普防、江防、鐵路巡防為五路，凡四十七營。

translations.literal: Xi Liang had Yunnan’s twenty-seven defense battalions, eleven railway patrol battalions, and one native volunteer battalion—thirty-nine battalions in all—reorganized in turn into the new army; the province-wide quota was two hundred fifty men per defense battalion; they were divided into five routes—Southern Defense, Western Defense, Pu’er Defense, River Defense, and Railway Patrol—for forty-seven battalions in all.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Liang gradually converted Yunnan’s thirty-nine defense, railway patrol, and native volunteer battalions into the new army, fixing defense battalions at 250 men each and organizing forty-seven battalions across five routes: south, west, Pu’er, river, and railway patrol.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，以熱河巡防強勝營改編常備軍，以察哈爾原有之精壯、精健等營改編為巡防馬隊一營，步隊二營。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, Rehe’s patrol garrison Qiangsheng battalion was reorganized as standing forces; Chahar’s original Jingzhuang, Jingjian, and other battalions were reorganized as one patrol cavalry battalion and two infantry battalions.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong Rehe’s Qiangsheng patrol battalion became standing forces, and Chahar’s Jingzhuang and Jingjian battalions were reorganized into one patrol cavalry battalion and two infantry battalions.

sentences.zh: 徐世昌以奉天巡防隊分駐五路剿匪，旋合編為步隊一標，其河防營亦一律改編。

translations.literal: Xu Shichang had Fengtian’s patrol garrisons distributed on five routes to suppress bandits; they were then combined and reorganized as one infantry regiment; the river-defense camps were also uniformly reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shichang posted Fengtian’s patrol garrisons on five bandit-suppression routes, then merged them into one infantry regiment and reorganized the river-defense camps on the same model.

sentences.zh: 王士珍因江南防軍步隊六營、砲隊二營改隸江北，乃合原有之巡防隊及留防各營編為巡防第七營，共巡防步隊八營，以備練成一鎮，原有衛隊，增募一哨，編為一營，尚有練軍三百人，水師十棚，均改為巡防隊。

translations.literal: Because six infantry battalions and two artillery battalions of Jiangnan’s defense forces were transferred to northern Jiangsu, Wang Shizhen combined the original patrol garrisons and remaining garrison battalions into the Seventh Patrol Battalion—for eight patrol infantry battalions in all, preparing to drill them into one brigade; the original guard unit added one recruited platoon and was organized as one battalion; there were also three hundred training force men and ten naval sheds, all converted to patrol garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: When six Jiangnan infantry and two artillery battalions moved to northern Jiangsu, Wang Shizhen merged the remaining patrol and garrison units into eight patrol infantry battalions—including a new Seventh Battalion—aiming at a full brigade; he expanded the guard into a battalion and converted 300 training troops and ten naval sheds into patrol garrisons.

sentences.zh: 沈秉堃以雲南防軍內有各屬之保衛隊，系舊日團營，名為營隊，實即鄉團，未能遽改為巡防隊。

translations.literal: Shen Bingkun noted that within Yunnan’s defense forces there were subordinate guard units that were old regiment camps in name only but were in fact local militia, and could not immediately be converted to patrol garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Bingkun explained that Yunnan’s subordinate “guard units” were really old local militia still called battalions, and could not yet be turned into formal patrol garrisons.

sentences.zh: 廣福以伊犁軍標漢隊，系金順西征營勇之舊，其營制餉章，均仿湘軍，乃遵新章，以步隊一營、馬隊二旗為左路巡防隊，馬隊二旗為右路巡防隊，分駐惠遠、惠寧各城。

translations.literal: Guang Fu noted that the Ili army banner’s Han companies were the old camp volunteers of Jin Shun’s western expedition; their camp organization and pay regulations all imitated the Xiang Army; following the new regulations, one infantry battalion and two cavalry banners became the Left Route patrol garrison, and two cavalry banners the Right Route patrol garrison, garrisoned separately at the cities of Huiyuan and Huining.
translations.idiomatic: Guang Fu explained that the Han companies of the Ili banner descended from Jin Shun’s western expedition volunteers on the Xiang Army model; under the new rules he formed a Left Route patrol garrison of one infantry battalion and two cavalry banners and a Right Route patrol garrison of two cavalry banners, posted at Huiyuan and Huining.

sentences.zh: 袁樹勛以山東省原駐淮軍，於光緒二十四年移防長江，新增防兵二營駐兗、沂二府及德州，均當南北要道，未能遽裁。

translations.literal: Yuan Shuxun noted that Shandong’s originally stationed Huai Army had been transferred to the Yangtze in the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu; two newly added defense battalions garrisoned Yanzhou and Yizhou prefectures and Dezhou, all on major north-south routes, and could not immediately be cut.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shuxun reported that Shandong’s Huai garrison had moved to the Yangtze in 1898, leaving two new defense battalions at Yanzhou, Yizhou, and Dezhou on vital north-south lines that could not yet be disbanded.

sentences.zh: 聯魁以新疆籌餉維艱，就原有防營改編為步隊三營、馬隊二營，又增編工程兵一隊，馬隊一營，勉成一協。

translations.literal: Lian Kui held that raising pay in Xinjiang was extremely difficult; from the original defense camps he reorganized three infantry battalions and two cavalry battalions, and further added one engineering squad and one cavalry battalion, barely forming one brigade.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Kui, with Xinjiang’s finances stretched thin, reorganized existing defense camps into three infantry and two cavalry battalions, added an engineering squad and another cavalry battalion, and barely scraped together one brigade.

sentences.zh: 寶棻以山西省軍隊，向分太原、大同、口外三大支巡防隊，乃歸併分編為中、前、後三路，各以統領節制之，凡馬步二十二隊。

translations.literal: Bao Fen noted that Shanxi’s armies had formerly been divided into three major patrol garrison branches at Taiyuan, Datong, and beyond the passes; he merged and reorganized them into Central, Front, and Rear routes, each under a commander’s control—twenty-two cavalry and infantry squads in all.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Fen consolidated Shanxi’s three old patrol branches at Taiyuan, Datong, and beyond the passes into Central, Front, and Rear routes under single commanders—twenty-two cavalry and infantry squads in all.

sentences.zh: 吳重熹以河南省巡防營不合部章，就通省巡防步隊二十八營、馬隊十二營分為五路，豫正左軍為中路，南陽鎮為前路，歸德鎮為左路，河州鎮為右路，豫正右軍為後路。

translations.literal: Wu Zhongxi held that Henan’s patrol garrisons did not conform to ministry regulations; from the province-wide twenty-eight patrol infantry battalions and twelve cavalry battalions he divided five routes: the Yuzheng Left Army as the Central Route, Nanyang garrison as the Front Route, Guide garrison as the Left Route, Hezhou garrison as the Right Route, and the Yuzheng Right Army as the Rear Route.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhongxi found Henan’s patrol garrisons out of compliance and reorganized the province’s twenty-eight infantry and twelve cavalry patrol battalions into five routes: Central (Yuzheng Left), Front (Nanyang), Left (Guide), Right (Hezhou), and Rear (Yuzheng Right).

sentences.zh: 趙爾巽以四川省防軍二十九營，編為六軍，每軍六營，分中、前、後、左、右、副中為六路，分駐防境。

translations.literal: Zhao Erxun reorganized Sichuan’s twenty-nine defense battalions into six armies of six battalions each, divided into Central, Front, Rear, Left, Right, and Deputy Central routes, garrisoned across the defense districts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erxun formed Sichuan’s twenty-nine defense battalions into six six-battalion armies on Central, Front, Rear, Left, Right, and Deputy Central routes posted across the province.

sentences.zh: 其防守寧遠之靖字二營、游擊步隊二營，增募寧遠之靖字後營，改為巡防副左路、副右路兩軍，每三營為一軍。

translations.literal: The two Jing-character battalions and two detached infantry battalions defending Ningyuan, together with the newly recruited Jing Rear battalion at Ningyuan, were reorganized as the Deputy Left Route and Deputy Right Route patrol armies, three battalions per army.
translations.idiomatic: The two Jing-designated battalions, two detached infantry battalions, and a newly raised Jing Rear battalion at Ningyuan became Deputy Left and Deputy Right patrol armies of three battalions each.

sentences.zh: 成都駐防滿營亦改編巡防隊三營，俾臻一律。

translations.literal: The Manchu garrison at Chengdu was also reorganized into three patrol garrison battalions, so that all would be uniform.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu’s Manchu garrison was likewise reorganized into three patrol battalions for uniformity.

sentences.zh: 瑞澂以江蘇省各營練成一協外，尚有太湖水師巡防隊、陸師左右巡防隊，系陸路三旗及蘇捕營衛隊等先後改編者，乃次第換防調操，以免弛懈。

translations.literal: Rui Cheng noted that apart from drilling Jiangsu’s various battalions into one brigade, there were also the Taihu naval patrol garrison, the Left and Right land patrol garrisons—reorganized in turn from three land-route banners and the Suzhou pursuit camp guards; he therefore rotated garrisons and adjusted drill in sequence to prevent slackness.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Cheng, beyond forming one brigade from Jiangsu’s battalions, also had Taihu naval patrol units and left and right land patrol forces converted from land banners and Suzhou pursuit guards; he rotated posts and drills to keep them from going slack.

sentences.zh: 二年，岑春蓂改編湖南省巡防隊，酌定餉章，即日成軍，其餘緝私三旗，改為南路巡防隊。

translations.literal: In the second year, Cen Chunming reorganized Hunan’s patrol garrisons, fixed the pay regulations, and formed the army immediately; the remaining three anti-smuggling banners were converted to the Southern Route patrol garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Cen Chunming reorganized Hunan’s patrol garrisons, set their pay scale, and stood them up at once; three anti-smuggling banners became the Southern Route patrol garrison.

sentences.zh: 孫寶琦改編山東省巡防隊，所有中、前、後、左、右五路，各就坐營之中哨改編，其砲隊以快砲六尊為一隊，各府州縣巡勇悉改為巡防隊，兗、沂、曹三府原有之巡防營，亦遵新章編練。

translations.literal: Sun Baoqi reorganized Shandong’s patrol garrisons; all five routes—Central, Front, Rear, Left, and Right—were reorganized from the center platoon of each stationed camp; artillery units took six quick-firing guns as one squad; patrol volunteers of every prefecture, department, and county were all converted to patrol garrisons; the original patrol camps of Yanzhou, Yizhou, and Caozhou prefectures were also drilled and organized under the new regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Baoqi reorganized Shandong’s five patrol routes from each camp’s center platoon, formed artillery squads of six quick-firing guns, converted every county patrol volunteer unit into patrol garrisons, and brought Yanzhou, Yizhou, and Caozhou’s old patrol camps under the new drill scheme.

sentences.zh: 恩壽以陝西省巡警軍悉改為巡防隊。

translations.literal: En Shou converted all of Shaanxi’s constabulary army to patrol garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: En Shou converted all of Shaanxi’s constabulary troops into patrol garrisons.

sentences.zh: 楊文鼎以湖南省巡防隊分為中、東、西、南四路，駐防各府。

translations.literal: Yang Wending divided Hunan’s patrol garrisons into Central, Eastern, Western, and Southern routes, garrisoned in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wending split Hunan’s patrol garrisons into Central, Eastern, Western, and Southern routes posted across the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 昆源以察哈爾八旗壯丁編練巡防馬隊。

translations.literal: Kunyuan selected and drilled able-bodied banner men of Chahar into patrol cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Kunyuan recruited and drilled Chahar banner militia into patrol cavalry.

sentences.zh: 松壽以裁撤福建全省之綠營兵改為巡防隊十六營，分五路駐防各府。

translations.literal: Song Shou converted the cut Green Standard troops of all Fujian into sixteen patrol garrison battalions, distributed on five routes to garrison the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shou turned Fujian’s disbanded Green Standard troops into sixteen patrol battalions on five routes across the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 張人駿以兩江巡緝隊及師船十艘改為探訪隊，其沿江巡防隊深資得力，以協解北洋之淮軍餉為巡防軍餉，並以江防軍分駐江寧省城。

translations.literal: Zhang Renjun converted the Two Jiangs patrol corps and ten command vessels into an investigation corps; the river-bank patrol garrisons were deeply useful; the Huai Army pay coordinated from Beiyang was used as patrol garrison pay, and river-defense troops were distributed to garrison the Jiangning provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Renjun turned the Two Jiangs patrol corps and ten command vessels into an investigation corps, funded patrol garrisons from coordinated Huai Army pay from Beiyang, and posted river-defense troops in the Jiangning capital.

sentences.zh: 錫良以奉天原有之協巡隊、備補隊、砲隊、衛隊各防營，遵章改編為陸軍步隊一標、砲隊一營。

translations.literal: Xi Liang had Fengtian’s original auxiliary patrol, reserve, artillery, and guard defense camps reorganized under regulations as one Army infantry regiment and one artillery battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Liang reorganized Fengtian’s auxiliary patrol, reserve, artillery, and guard camps into one Army infantry regiment and one artillery battalion.

sentences.zh: 是年，山東、山西撫臣咸擬緩裁巡防軍，以靖地方。

translations.literal: That year, the governors of Shandong and Shanxi both proposed delaying cuts to patrol garrisons in order to pacify the localities.
translations.idiomatic: That year the governors of Shandong and Shanxi both urged postponing cuts to patrol garrisons to keep the peace locally.

sentences.zh: 三年，張人駿以兩江巡防軍關係重要，其屬於江寧者，馬步三十二營，屬於江蘇者，步隊六營，屬於江北者，步隊八營一哨、馬隊一營，江南北地勢扼要，未可議裁，並擬以新兵中副二營留防三隊改為第一、二、三巡防隊，以一哨為提督衛隊。

translations.literal: In the third year, Zhang Renjun held that the Two Jiangs patrol garrisons were critically important: those belonging to Jiangning numbered thirty-two cavalry and infantry battalions; those belonging to Jiangsu, six infantry battalions; those belonging to northern Jiangsu, eight infantry battalions and one platoon plus one cavalry battalion; the terrain north and south of the river was strategically vital and cuts could not be discussed; he also proposed converting three retained garrison squads from two deputy battalions of the new army into the First, Second, and Third patrol garrisons, with one platoon as the provincial commander’s guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Zhang Renjun argued that Two Jiangs patrol forces were too important to cut: thirty-two cavalry and infantry battalions at Jiangning, six infantry battalions in Jiangsu, and eight infantry battalions, one platoon, and one cavalry battalion in northern Jiangsu guarded terrain too vital to reduce. He proposed forming three patrol units from retained new-army squads and one platoon as the provincial commander’s guard.

sentences.zh: 丁寶銓以山西太原滿營，於光緒二十八年已改練新操，乃遵章改編為巡防隊。

translations.literal: Ding Baoquan noted that Taiyuan’s Manchu garrison in Shanxi had already adopted the new drill in the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu; it was therefore reorganized as a patrol garrison under the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Baoquan reported that Taiyuan’s Manchu garrison, on the new drill since 1902, was reorganized as a patrol garrison under the regulations.

sentences.zh: 恩壽以陝西省巡警軍已改編巡防隊，並設馬步巡防營務處。

translations.literal: En Shou reported that Shaanxi’s constabulary army had already been reorganized as patrol garrisons, and a cavalry-and-infantry patrol camp affairs office was also established.
translations.idiomatic: En Shou reported that Shaanxi’s constabulary had become patrol garrisons and that a joint cavalry-infantry patrol affairs office had been set up.

sentences.zh: 慶恕以青海墾荒，已開墾六萬餘畝，原有巡防隊不敷分佈，增練防軍一旗。

translations.literal: Qing Shu reported that land reclamation in Qinghai had already opened over sixty thousand mu; the original patrol garrisons were insufficient for distribution; one banner of defense forces was added by drill.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Shu reported that with more than 60,000 mu reclaimed in Qinghai, existing patrol garrisons could not cover the ground, so one defense banner was added.

sentences.zh: 誠勛以熱河雖有直隸練軍八營，僅防朝、建一帶，其先後所練巡防隊十三營，分防各屬，未能遽改陸軍。

translations.literal: Cheng Xun noted that although Rehe had eight Zhili training battalions, they defended only the Chaoyang and Jianping region; the thirteen patrol garrison battalions drilled in succession and distributed among the dependencies could not immediately be converted to the Army.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xun explained that Rehe’s eight Zhili training battalions covered only Chaoyang and Jianping, and its thirteen newly drilled patrol battalions scattered across the prefecture could not yet become formal Army units.

sentences.zh: 張勳以長江巡防馬、步、砲隊十三營，分駐浦口、六合、江寧、蘇州、懷遠各府縣，並在沿江一帶廣布偵探，以靖盜源。

translations.literal: Zhang Xun had thirteen Yangtze patrol cavalry, infantry, and artillery battalions distributed to garrison Pukou, Luhe, Jiangning, Suzhou, Huaiyuan, and other prefectures and counties, and broadly deployed scouts along the riverbank to pacify the sources of banditry.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xun posted thirteen Yangtze patrol cavalry, infantry, and artillery battalions at Pukou, Luhe, Jiangning, Suzhou, Huaiyuan, and other counties and spread scouts along the river to choke off bandit networks.

sentences.zh: 瑞澂以湖南六營已裁，所有撫標之兵，選精壯編巡防一營。

translations.literal: Rui Cheng reported that six Hunan battalions had already been cut; from all the provincial banner troops, the elite were selected and organized as one patrol garrison battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Cheng reported that after six Hunan battalions were disbanded, picked men from the provincial banner force were formed into one patrol battalion.

sentences.zh: 此改設防練軍之大略也。

translations.literal: This is the general outline of the reorganization of defense and training forces.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the broad pattern of reorganizing defense and training forces.

sentences.zh: 自咸豐軍興，由綠營改為勇營，為留防營，為練軍，為巡防隊，為陸軍，兵制變而益新。

translations.literal: From the military rise in the Xianfeng reign, troops passed from Green Standard to volunteer camps, to retained defense camps, to training forces, to patrol garrisons, to the Army—the military system changed and grew ever newer.
translations.idiomatic: From the Xianfeng wars onward, forces evolved from Green Standard troops to volunteer camps, retained defense camps, training forces, patrol garrisons, and finally the Army—the military system renewing itself at each stage.

sentences.zh: 至宣統年，非特綠營盡汰，即湘、淮營勇駐防南北洋者，所存亦無幾矣。

translations.literal: By the Xuantong years, not only were the Green Standard forces entirely eliminated; even the Xiang and Huai camp volunteers garrisoned on the northern and southern coasts had scarcely any left.
translations.idiomatic: By the Xuantong era the Green Standard was gone altogether, and the Xiang and Huai volunteers once posted on the northern and southern coasts had nearly vanished as well.

sentences.zh: 陸軍新制，始於甲午戰後，步軍統領榮祿疏保溫處道袁世凱練新軍，是曰新建陸軍。

translations.literal: The new Army system began after the Sino-Japanese War; Infantry Commander Ronglu memorialized recommending Wenzhou circuit intendant Yuan Shikai to drill a new army—this was called the Newly Created Army.
translations.idiomatic: The modern Army system began after the Sino-Japanese War, when Infantry Commander Ronglu recommended Wenzhou circuit intendant Yuan Shikai to raise a new force—the Newly Created Army.

sentences.zh: 復練兵小站，名曰定武軍。

translations.literal: He also drilled troops at Xiaozhan, called the Dingwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan also drilled troops at Xiaozhan in what became the Dingwu Army.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督張之洞聘德人教練新軍，名曰江南自強軍。

translations.literal: Two Jiangs Governor-General Zhang Zhidong hired Germans to drill a new army, called the Jiangnan Self-Strengthening Army.
translations.idiomatic: Two Jiangs Governor-General Zhang Zhidong hired German instructors to raise the Jiangnan Self-Strengthening Army.

sentences.zh: 其後榮祿以兵部尚書協辦大學士節制北洋海陸各軍，益練新軍，是為武衛軍。

translations.literal: Afterward Ronglu, as Minister of War and Associate Grand Secretary, took command of all Beiyang land and sea forces, further drilled new armies—this was the Wuwei Army.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as Minister of War and Associate Grand Secretary commanding all Beiyang land and sea forces, Ronglu expanded the new armies into the Wuwei Army.

sentences.zh: 庚子亂後，各省皆起練新軍，或就防軍改編，或用新式招練。

translations.literal: After the disorders of 1900, every province began drilling new armies, either by reorganizing defense forces or by recruiting and drilling in the new manner.
translations.idiomatic: After the Boxer upheaval of 1900 every province set about raising new armies, either by converting defense forces or by fresh recruitment on the new model.

sentences.zh: 至光緒三十年，畫定軍制，京師設練兵處，各省設督練公所，改定新軍區為三十六鎮，新軍制始畫一。

translations.literal: By the thirtieth year of Guangxu the military system was fixed: an Army Training Office was established in the capital, training supervision offices in each province, and the new army districts were set at thirty-six brigades—the new army system was first unified.
translations.idiomatic: By 1904 the system was codified: Beijing got an Army Training Office, each province a training supervision office, and the new army was divided into thirty-six brigades—finally bringing the new force under one standard.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，京、外新練陸軍，除禁衛軍外，統計近畿第一鎮駐京北仰山窪，官七百四十八員，兵一萬一千七百六十四名。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, newly drilled Army forces in the capital and provinces—apart from the Imperial Guard—totaled, for example, the First Brigade of the metropolitan region garrisoned at Yangshanwa north of Beijing: seven hundred forty-eight officers and eleven thousand seven hundred sixty-four soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In 1907, counting newly drilled Army units in the capital and provinces apart from the Imperial Guard, the First Brigade of the metropolitan region alone—garrisoned at Yangshanwa north of Beijing—numbered 748 officers and 11,764 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 第六鎮駐南苑，官七百四十七員，兵一萬一千八百四十六名。

translations.literal: The Sixth Brigade garrisoned Nanyuan: seven hundred forty-seven officers and eleven thousand eight hundred forty-six soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Sixth Brigade was posted at Nanyuan with 747 officers and 11,846 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 直隸第二鎮駐保定、永平等府，官七百三十七員，兵一萬一千七百三十一名。

translations.literal: Zhili’s Second Brigade garrisoned Baoding, Yongping, and other prefectures: seven hundred thirty-seven officers and eleven thousand seven hundred thirty-one soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili’s Second Brigade held Baoding, Yongping, and neighboring prefectures with 737 officers and 11,731 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 第四鎮駐馬廠，官七百四十八員，兵一萬一千七百五十六名。

translations.literal: The Fourth Brigade garrisoned Machang: seven hundred forty-eight officers and eleven thousand seven hundred fifty-six soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Fourth Brigade was stationed at Machang with 748 officers and 11,756 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 山東第五鎮駐省城、濰縣、昌邑等處，官七百四十八員，兵一萬一千七百六十四名。

translations.literal: Shandong’s Fifth Brigade garrisoned the provincial capital, Weixian, Changyi, and other places: seven hundred forty-eight officers and eleven thousand seven hundred sixty-four soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong’s Fifth Brigade was distributed across the provincial capital, Weixian, Changyi, and other posts with 748 officers and 11,764 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 江蘇第二十三混成協駐蘇州等處，官二百七十四員，兵四千三百四十五名。

translations.literal: Jiangsu’s Twenty-third Mixed Brigade garrisoned Suzhou and other places: two hundred seventy-four officers and four thousand three hundred forty-five soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu’s Twenty-third Mixed Brigade held Suzhou and nearby posts with 274 officers and 4,345 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 江北第十三混成協駐清江浦，官三百七十六員，兵二千四百八十一名。

translations.literal: Northern Jiangsu’s Thirteenth Mixed Brigade garrisoned Qingjiangpu: three hundred seventy-six officers and two thousand four hundred eighty-one soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Jiangsu’s Thirteenth Mixed Brigade was posted at Qingjiangpu with 376 officers and 2,481 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 安徽步隊二標、馬隊一營、砲隊一隊駐省城，官二百五十三員，兵四千一百五十五名。

translations.literal: Anhui’s two infantry regiments, one cavalry battalion, and one artillery squad garrisoned the provincial capital: two hundred fifty-three officers and four thousand one hundred fifty-five soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui kept two infantry regiments, one cavalry battalion, and one artillery squad at the provincial capital—253 officers and 4,155 soldiers in all.

sentences.zh: 江南第九鎮步隊一營、馬隊二隊駐省城，官七百八十九員，兵八千二百五十五名。

translations.literal: Jiangnan’s Ninth Brigade—one infantry battalion and two cavalry squads—garrisoned the provincial capital: seven hundred eighty-nine officers and eight thousand two hundred fifty-five soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan’s Ninth Brigade, with one infantry battalion and two cavalry squads at the provincial capital, fielded 789 officers and 8,255 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 江西步隊一協、馬隊二隊駐省城，官二百三十一員，兵四千二百八十七名。

translations.literal: Jiangxi’s one infantry brigade and two cavalry squads garrisoned the provincial capital: two hundred thirty-one officers and four thousand two hundred eighty-seven soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi posted one infantry brigade and two cavalry squads at the provincial capital—231 officers and 4,287 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 河南第二十九混成協駐省城，官三百三十八員，兵五千六百十八名，步隊一協、馬砲隊各一營調駐京城，官一百六十二員，兵三千八十五名。

translations.literal: Henan’s Twenty-ninth Mixed Brigade garrisoned the provincial capital: three hundred thirty-eight officers and five thousand six hundred eighteen soldiers; one infantry brigade and one each of cavalry and artillery battalions were transferred to garrison the capital: one hundred sixty-two officers and three thousand eighty-five soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Henan’s Twenty-ninth Mixed Brigade at the provincial capital had 338 officers and 5,618 soldiers; an infantry brigade plus cavalry and artillery battalions were also detached to the capital with 162 officers and 3,085 men.

sentences.zh: 湖南步隊一協、砲隊一營駐省城，官二百四十八員，兵四千五十六名。

translations.literal: Hunan’s one infantry brigade and one artillery battalion garrisoned the provincial capital: two hundred forty-eight officers and four thousand fifty-six soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan kept one infantry brigade and one artillery battalion at the provincial capital—248 officers and 4,056 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 湖北第八鎮駐省城，官七百二員，兵一萬五百二名，第二十一混成協駐武昌、漢陽及京漢鐵路，官二百八十八員，兵四千六百十二名。

translations.literal: Hubei’s Eighth Brigade garrisoned the provincial capital: seven hundred two officers and ten thousand five hundred two soldiers; the Twenty-first Mixed Brigade garrisoned Wuchang, Hanyang, and the Beijing-Hankou Railway: two hundred eighty-eight officers and four thousand six hundred twelve soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei’s Eighth Brigade at the provincial capital numbered 702 officers and 10,502 soldiers; the Twenty-first Mixed Brigade held Wuchang, Hanyang, and the Beijing-Hankou line with 288 officers and 4,612 men.

sentences.zh: 浙江步隊一協駐省城，官一百五十九員，兵二千三百八十四名。

translations.literal: Zhejiang’s one infantry brigade garrisoned the provincial capital: one hundred fifty-nine officers and two thousand three hundred eighty-four soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang posted one infantry brigade at the provincial capital with 159 officers and 2,384 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 福建第十鎮駐省城及福寧、延平等處，官四百五十五員，兵六千七百八十八名。

translations.literal: Fujian’s Tenth Brigade garrisoned the provincial capital and Funing, Yanping, and other places: four hundred fifty-five officers and six thousand seven hundred eighty-eight soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian’s Tenth Brigade covered the provincial capital, Funing, Yanping, and other posts with 455 officers and 6,788 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 雲南步隊一協、砲隊一營駐省城及臨安，官二百三十八員，兵四千二百四十八名。

translations.literal: Yunnan’s one infantry brigade and one artillery battalion garrisoned the provincial capital and Lin’an: two hundred thirty-eight officers and four thousand two hundred forty-eight soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan kept one infantry brigade and one artillery battalion at the provincial capital and Lin’an—238 officers and 4,248 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 貴州步隊一標、砲隊一隊駐省城，官一百七員，兵一千八百四十六名。

translations.literal: Guizhou’s one infantry regiment and one artillery squad garrisoned the provincial capital: one hundred seven officers and one thousand eight hundred forty-six soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou fielded one infantry regiment and one artillery squad at the provincial capital—107 officers and 1,846 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 四川步隊駐省城，官十二員，兵六十一名。

translations.literal: Sichuan’s infantry garrisoned the provincial capital: twelve officers and sixty-one soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan’s infantry detachment at the provincial capital mustered only twelve officers and sixty-one soldiers.

sentences.zh: 山西步隊二標、馬砲隊各一營駐省城，官二百六十二員，兵四千五百五十七名。

translations.literal: Shanxi’s two infantry regiments and one each of cavalry and artillery battalions garrisoned the provincial capital: two hundred sixty-two officers and four thousand five hundred fifty-seven soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi kept two infantry regiments plus cavalry and artillery battalions at the provincial capital—262 officers and 4,557 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 陝西步隊一協、砲隊一隊駐省城，官二百二十員，兵三千九百三十六名。

translations.literal: Shaanxi’s one infantry brigade and one artillery squad garrisoned the provincial capital: two hundred twenty officers and three thousand nine hundred thirty-six soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi posted one infantry brigade and one artillery squad at the provincial capital with 220 officers and 3,936 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 甘肅步隊二標、砲隊一營駐省城、河州、固原、西寧，官二百二十一員，兵四千一百二十八名。

translations.literal: Gansu’s two infantry regiments and one artillery battalion garrisoned the provincial capital, Hezhou, Guyuan, and Xining: two hundred twenty-one officers and four thousand one hundred twenty-eight soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu distributed two infantry regiments and an artillery battalion across the provincial capital, Hezhou, Guyuan, and Xining—221 officers and 4,128 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 新疆步隊一協、馬隊一標、砲隊一營駐省城，官一百六十七員，兵二千三百二十二名。

translations.literal: Xinjiang’s one infantry brigade, one cavalry regiment, and one artillery battalion garrisoned the provincial capital: one hundred sixty-seven officers and two thousand three hundred twenty-two soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang kept one infantry brigade, one cavalry regiment, and one artillery battalion at the provincial capital—167 officers and 2,322 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 東三省第三鎮駐吉林省城、長春、寧安、延吉及奉天錦州等處，官七百五十三員，兵一萬一千八百八十三名，第一混成協駐奉天省城，官三百三員，兵三千五十九名，第二混成協駐奉天新民等處，官三百四員，兵五千五十三名，步隊一協一標、砲隊一營駐吉林，官三百六十一員，兵七千八百七十名。

translations.literal: The Three Eastern Provinces’ Third Brigade garrisoned Jilin provincial capital, Changchun, Ning’an, Yanji, and Fengtian’s Jinzhou and other places: seven hundred fifty-three officers and eleven thousand eight hundred eighty-three soldiers; the First Mixed Brigade garrisoned Fengtian provincial capital: three hundred three officers and three thousand fifty-nine soldiers; the Second Mixed Brigade garrisoned Fengtian’s Xinmin and other places: three hundred four officers and five thousand fifty-three soldiers; one infantry brigade and one regiment plus one artillery battalion garrisoned Jilin: three hundred sixty-one officers and seven thousand eight hundred seventy soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Northeast’s Third Brigade held Jilin city, Changchun, Ning’an, Yanji, Jinzhou, and other posts with 753 officers and 11,883 soldiers. The First Mixed Brigade at Fengtian’s capital had 303 officers and 3,059 men; the Second Mixed Brigade at Xinmin and elsewhere had 304 officers and 5,053 men; and Jilin hosted an infantry brigade and regiment plus an artillery battalion with 361 officers and 7,870 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年統計，除前列外，浙江成第二十一鎮，雲南成第十九鎮，四川成第十七鎮，奉天成第二十鎮，吉林成第二十三鎮，廣東成第二十六鎮駐省城，廣西成第二十五鎮駐省城及桂林等處，先後共成二十六鎮。

translations.literal: Statistics for the third year of Xuantong: apart from those listed above, Zhejiang became the Twenty-first Brigade, Yunnan the Nineteenth, Sichuan the Seventeenth, Fengtian the Twentieth, Jilin the Twenty-third, Guangdong the Twenty-sixth garrisoned at the provincial capital, Guangxi the Twenty-fifth garrisoned at the provincial capital and Guilin and other places—in all twenty-six brigades were formed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: By the third year of Xuantong, beyond the units already listed, Zhejiang became the Twenty-first Brigade, Yunnan the Nineteenth, Sichuan the Seventeenth, Fengtian the Twentieth, Jilin the Twenty-third, Guangdong the Twenty-sixth at the provincial capital, and Guangxi the Twenty-fifth at the capital and Guilin—twenty-six brigades in all, formed one after another.

sentences.zh: 未幾，武昌陸軍先變，各省應之，而三十六鎮卒未全立雲。

translations.literal: Before long the Army at Wuchang mutinied first, the provinces responded in turn, and the thirty-six brigades in the end were never fully established.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Wuchang garrison rose first, the provinces followed, and the planned thirty-six brigades were never fully realized.
